# Ultrasound Assisted RF Microneedling Technology.


### Revealing That Beauty Lies Just Beyond the Surface

[ Book Your Demo ][24]

UltraVision™ takes skincare to the next level by combining two technologies into one personalized
treatment. With industry-first ultrasound visualization and unmatched precision, UltraVision™ offers
ultrasound imaging, mapping, and an exclusive Uniform RF Microneedling delivery system. Your
patients will appreciate the precise and personalized results they’ll achieve.


Personalized Treatment Settings
Ultrasound Skin Depth Precision
Colorblind Versatility
Minimal Downtime
Uniform Energy Delivery

Since 2016, Aesthetics Biomedical® Inc. has pioneered technologies that

## What Customer Say About

## UltraVision^{™}

There is something about UltraVision™ that is special – the downtime is significantly less than
regular microneedling. After multiple treatments, I feel like my makeup just glides over my skin.

I like to call it the Benjamin Button facial. It’s literally my go-to treatment.

**Jennifer Saviano, ABC’s The Bachelor & Bachelor in Paradise**

I recently completed my series of three UltraVision™ treatments and am thrilled with the results. I
am in my 60s but feel like my face makes me look closer to 40. As someone who has tried several
topical products and a few treatments, UltraVision™ is the one that has the most value and impact.
Some treatment areas feel smooth enough I don’t feel the need for injections. After my treatments, I
experience minimal redness that fades quickly. I plan to keep up with my treatments and hope to get
a series to focus on my eye area with the new smaller tip. This is a treatment I’d recommend to
anyone looking for a minimally invasive treatment with maximum results.

**- Karen M., 63 years old**

UltraVision™ is the first aesthetic treatment I have tried and am very happy with the results. After
each treatment, I notice my complexion appears more even and my skin feels tighter. As a busy mom, I
appreciate that there is minimal down time and I can go right back to any kid-related activities the
same day of my treatment, as long as I avoid the sun for twenty-four hours. My provider was able to
personalize the treatment settings to each area of my face and ensured I was comfortable. The
topical numbing cream made it virtually pain free and I loved how the cooling mask applied after
each treatment made for a relaxing experience.

**- Tracey T., 39 years old**

I have now had three treatments with the new device. Having had microneedling with other products
before, I thought I knew what to expect from the treatment, but this treatment was different. First,
I have had little to no redness, bruising, or tightness immediately following treatment. This was
huge, especially since I had appointments/meetings right after the treatments and did not have to
worry about the appearance of my face or having to schedule “down time”. The second difference from
previous treatments is that within two weeks of my first treatment, I noticed a difference: several
of my lines/wrinkles, especially my laugh lines, were not as deep. I could easily see the
improvement in the mirror. I recently was at my hairdresser who asked me what I had been doing, as
she, too, noticed my skin’s improvement. The treatment itself was painless, although you can
definitely feel it. All in all, I’m very happy with the results.

**- Debra P., 67 years old**

# **Saving Lives Through the Power of Plasma**

Some diseases can only be treated with medicines made with plasma. Since plasma can’t be made
synthetically, many people rely on plasma donors like you to live healthier, happier lives.

Donate NowLearn More
[Three friends laughing]

## **Why Choose BioLife?**

Donating plasma is a wonderful way to help patients facing serious health challenges. We want to
make this experience safe, easy, and rewarding for donors who want to make a difference.

## **Get Compensated For Your Time**

Plasma can’t be made in a lab. So, people with rare and complex diseases rely on donors like you to
live fuller lives. Knowing you’re helping others is the best feeling in the world. And getting paid
for your time is a great way to boost your budget.

[BioLife Debit Card. When you donate, you'll receive compensation on a BioLife Debit Card that works
wherever Debit Mastercard is accepted.]

####  

#### **BioLife Debit Card**

When you donate, you’ll receive compensation on a BioLife Debit Card that works wherever Debit
Mastercard is accepted.

[Buddy Bonus. You can also receive extra funds with our Buddy bonus when you refer a friend to
donate plasma.]

####  

#### **Buddy Bonus**

You can also receive extra funds with our Buddy Bonus when you refer a friend to donate plasma.

Learn More

## **What is Plasma Donation?**

##### Often referred to as “liquid gold,” plasma is the pale, yellow liquid that makes up about 55%
##### of your blood.

We separate plasma from your blood using a process called plasmapheresis. The plasma is then used to
produce various treatments and therapies. Since our bodies replenish plasma so easily, donation is
both a safe and admirable choice for donors.

Learn More

## **Get Compensated For Your Time**

Plasma can’t be made in a lab. So, people with rare and complex diseases rely on donors like you to
live fuller lives. Knowing you’re helping others is the best feeling in the world. And getting paid
for your time is a great way to boost your budget.

[BioLife Debit Card. When you donate, you'll receive compensation on a BioLife Debit Card that works
wherever Debit Mastercard is accepted.]

####  

#### **BioLife Debit Card**

When you donate, you’ll receive compensation on a BioLife Debit Card that works wherever Debit
Mastercard is accepted.

[Buddy Bonus. You can also receive extra funds with our Buddy bonus when you refer a friend to
donate plasma.]

####  

#### **Buddy Bonus**

You can also receive extra funds with our Buddy Bonus when you refer a friend to donate plasma.

Learn More

## **What is Plasma Donation?**

##### Often referred to as “liquid gold,” plasma is the pale, yellow liquid that makes up about 55%
##### of your blood.

We separate plasma from your blood using a process called plasmapheresis. The plasma is then used to
produce various treatments and therapies. Since our bodies replenish plasma so easily, donation is
both a safe and admirable choice for donors.

Learn More
[BioLife healthcare professional attending to a smiling donor.]

Home

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Find a Location ][149]

Location Search
Physicians in the licensed Regenexx^{®} network provide non-surgical options for individuals
experiencing pain related to orthopedic issues, including osteoarthritis, joint injuries, spine
pain, overuse conditions, and common sports injuries. Using proprietary, research-based methods and
patented protocol, they prepare and precisely apply injectates to support your body's natural
healing processes.

## Why Regenexx?

## Board-Certified Doctors

All physicians in the licensed Regenexx network are musculoskeletal specialists with expertise in
image-guided injections.
[Find a doctor near you][150]

## Locations Nationwide

Over 100 convenient locations nationwide focused on same-day treatment of orthopedic conditions,
injuries and pain without surgery.
[Find a location near you][151]

## Advanced Biotechnology

Regenexx lab processing routinely achieves 20x concentration of stem cell-containing bone marrow —
far above what non-Regenexx providers achieve.
[Learn about our approach][152]

## Over 21 Years of Results

Our research-based approach is supported by direct feedback from thousands of patients.
[Explore patient results][153]

## Specialties

##### Areas of Focus

##### Environmental and Chemical Sensitivities

Some clients are sensitive to certain environmental or chemical elements that can be found in every
day products or by just walking outside. We can work with you to identify the root causes and
develop a strategy to help mitigate sensitivities.

##### Migraines

Migraines are a very common problem it is estimated that about 35 million people suffer from
migraines in the US alone. It is important to get to the root cause of migraines instead of
suppressing them with pharmaceuticals. Migraines are a sign that something deeper is going on in the
body. Symptoms are a way the body communicates with us. Once the root cause is addressed, the
migraines will get better and typically go away. 

##### Parasitic Infection

It’s a common misconception that parasites are only contracted from underdeveloped countries or from
eating sushi. They are a much more common problem than most people realize. They can wreck havoc on
the body and deplete nutrients as well as cause a host of symptoms such as skin issues, digestive
problems, inability to lose weight, and much more. Some common signs that a person might be dealing
with a parasitic infection is eye floaters, grinding teeth, food sensitivities, sugar cravings, and
symptoms worsening around the full moon. 

The way parasites can be contracted are from contaminated/tap water, pets (pets are usually dewormed
every so often), walking barefoot outside in grass or soil, traveling, fresh foods, and undercooked
meats.

##### Lyme and Co-Infections

Lyme Disease is often times misdiagnosed because it is known to mimic so many other conditions. Many
clients will often see about an average of 10-12 doctors, before they are correctly diagnosed with
Lyme. Some symptoms of Lyme include fatigue, fevers, rashes, joint and muscle pain, joint swelling,
stiff neck, headaches, dizziness, brain fog, and so much more. Despite the common misconception that
Lyme is transmitted solely from a tick bite, the world-renowned Lyme research expert, Dr.
Klinghardt, says it can be transmitted by infected fleas, lice, and mosquitos as well.

[Gut Dysfunction]

##### Gut Dysfunction

Having a healthy digestive tract is essential to having a healthy body. That is why our gut is known
as our “second brain”. When the gut microbiome is in dysfunction, it can affect our brain health,
mood, energy, skin, sleep, and even the immune system. There are many digestive disorders becoming
more and more prevalent, such as Crohn’s Disease, ulcerative colitis, irritable bowel syndrome,
gastroesophageal reflux disease, small intestinal bacterial overgrowth, constipation, and many more.
Getting to the root cause can help relieve symptoms and help restore the body into balance. As
Hippocrates best said, “All diseases begin in the gut.”

and problems they are facing.

We’ve all heard the saying “you are what you eat”, in a sense this is completely true. It is
essential to be on a individualized diet that fits your body’s needs. Everyone is different and we
all react to foods differently. Instead of recommending one specific diet for everyone, I will
design a meal plan that targets the client’s health concerns. Eating clean while on any protocol is

for clients based on their individual issues and concerns.

### Tissue Regenix Group

Tissue Regenix Group is a pioneering, international medical technology company, focusing on the
development of regenerative products

[About Us][34]

### Our Vision

**Our vision is to establish Tissue Regenix Group as a leader in the science and innovation of
regenerative medicine. We are committed to transforming patient care and delivering favourable
health economic outcomes.**

[Our Technology][35]

### Our Mission

**Our mission is restoring patient function and vitality while honoring the gift of tissue
donation.**

[Donor Services][36]

### Regenerative Science

Regenerative medicine is an innovative and expanding field, researching the potential of tissue
engineering to offer a natural recovery by triggering a response through the body’s own cells, and
enable the natural regeneration of the patient’s own tissues.

[Read Our Story][37]

### Our Technology

We use our innovative platform technologies to address clinical needs in the regenerative medicine
market. Our technologies dCELL^{®} and BioRinse^{™} are complementary bone and soft tissue
platforms.

[Our Technology][38]

### **About Tissue Regenix Group**

Tissue Regenix Group are a leading manufacturer of allografts and xenografts processing products
that utilize our proprietary BioRinse™ and dCELL® technology platforms designed to enhance patient
outcomes.

We operate from two locations in San Antonio, Texas (formerly CellRight Technologies) and Leeds, UK.

Our San Antonio location processes, stores, and distributes Human Cells, Tissues, and Cellular and
Tissue-Based Products (HCT/P) to hospitals, medical professionals, and approved distribution
partners in compliance with the requirements of the FDA and state regulations, AATB Standards, and
other international requirements. We are AATB-accredited and registered with the FDA.

Our Leeds location houses our corporate offices and is responsible for porcine tissue medical device
manufacturing and distribution, including the OrthoPure® XT Ligament Reconstruction Implant. This
facility is certified to ISO 13485:2016. With strong connections to the University of Leeds, this
facility also acts as the research and development hub for potential future portfolio developments.

## Our Products

We focus on the development of regenerative products utilising our two platform technologies to
transform the treatment of patients and provide differentiated clinical outcomes in key clinical
areas.

Regenerative medicine is an innovative and expanding field, researching the potential of tissue
engineering to offer a natural recovery by triggering a response through the body’s own cells, and
enable the natural regeneration of the patient’s own tissues.

[Read Our Story][37]

### Our Technology

We use our innovative platform technologies to address clinical needs in the regenerative medicine
market. Our technologies dCELL^{®} and BioRinse^{™} are complementary bone and soft tissue
platforms.

[Our Technology][38]

### **About Tissue Regenix Group**

Tissue Regenix Group are a leading manufacturer of allografts and xenografts processing products
that utilize our proprietary BioRinse™ and dCELL® technology platforms designed to enhance patient
outcomes.

We operate from two locations in San Antonio, Texas (formerly CellRight Technologies) and Leeds, UK.

Our San Antonio location processes, stores, and distributes Human Cells, Tissues, and Cellular and
Tissue-Based Products (HCT/P) to hospitals, medical professionals, and approved distribution
partners in compliance with the requirements of the FDA and state regulations, AATB Standards, and
other international requirements. We are AATB-accredited and registered with the FDA.

Our Leeds location houses our corporate offices and is responsible for porcine tissue medical device
manufacturing and distribution, including the OrthoPure® XT Ligament Reconstruction Implant. This
facility is certified to ISO 13485:2016. With strong connections to the University of Leeds, this
facility also acts as the research and development hub for potential future portfolio developments.

## Our Products

We focus on the development of regenerative products utilising our two platform technologies to
transform the treatment of patients and provide differentiated clinical outcomes in key clinical
areas.

## Manufacturer Partners

We partner with the top manufacturers in Regenerative medicine such as EmCyte and Tulip as well as

#### 5 Line Biologics

If you are faced with choosing between multiple distributors representing many of the same top
manufacturers, then as both a consumer and a clinician, you should have two basic questions. First,
can they decrease my overall costs? Second, are their standards as high as mine?

[ Read More ][19]

#### Our Approach

We understand how complex and confusing the regenerative medicine space can be.

[ Read More ][20]

Whether you’re brand new to Regenerative Medicine or have been here for years, we can help.

[ Get In Touch ][21]

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Here are some great questions you have on your mind!

Does a distributor need to be registered with the state of NJ to sell medical devices there?

Yes. [NJAC 8:21-3A][22] is the applicable statute. You can verify a distribution
business [here][23]. Our registration number is 5005403.

Does my practice require a blood bank license to prepare PRP?

Yes. Under the provisions of [NJSA 26:2A][24] you will be required to obtain a blood bank license
for perioperative autologous blood collection/administration. It is a fairly easy process and we are
happy to help guide you through this.

Please call us at [609-975-9884][25] or send an e-mail to [info@5linemed.com][26] to request more
information.

[[5 line Biologics logo][5 line Biologics logo]][27]

We provide full in-service product support. We also offer one-on-one training conducted through
partner physicians experienced with these types of procedures. We will provide this training in your
office.

5-Line Biologics offers a complete line of regenerative medical products from industry leading
manufacturers such as EmCyte and Tulip. We have many years of experience providing technical and
clinical support across multiple regenerative platforms. We are Veteran-owned, and we pride
ourselves on delivering value and service that is unmatched.

#### Our Partners

## Manufacturer Partners

We partner with the top manufacturers in Regenerative medicine such as EmCyte and Tulip as well as
major medical and surgical supply manufacturers to bring you the absolute best products and value.

[ Explore More ][18]

#### 5 Line Biologics

If you are faced with choosing between multiple distributors representing many of the same top
manufacturers, then as both a consumer and a clinician, you should have two basic questions. First,
can they decrease my overall costs? Second, are their standards as high as mine?

[ Read More ][19]

#### Our Approach

We understand how complex and confusing the regenerative medicine space can be.

[ Read More ][20]

Whether you’re brand new to Regenerative Medicine or have been here for years, we can help.

[ Get In Touch ][21]

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Here are some great questions you have on your mind!

Does a distributor need to be registered with the state of NJ to sell medical devices there?

Yes. [NJAC 8:21-3A][22] is the applicable statute. You can verify a distribution
business [here][23]. Our registration number is 5005403.

Does my practice require a blood bank license to prepare PRP?

Yes. Under the provisions of [NJSA 26:2A][24] you will be required to obtain a blood bank license
for perioperative autologous blood collection/administration. It is a fairly easy process and we are
happy to help guide you through this.

Please call us at [609-975-9884][25] or send an e-mail to [info@5linemed.com][26] to request more
information.

## Featured Products & Solutions

We are a trusted leader in regenerative medicine, offering a wide range of evidence-based products
designed to enhance patient outcomes. Our solutions include minimally manipulated autologous cell
therapies and cutting-edge medical devices, tailored to meet the needs of modern healthcare
providers. We specialize in Orthopedics, Sports Medicine, and Pain Management while also supporting
providers in Dermatology, Plastic Surgery, Aesthetics, Urology, and OBGYN. Our mission is to deliver
value through high-quality, evidence-backed products and build lasting partnerships with healthcare
professionals. With the help of our dedicated Clinical Education Team, we ensure your staff receives
comprehensive training and ongoing support. From onboarding to optimizing workflows and creating
effective marketing strategies, we’re here to help your practice thrive.

## Biologic Modalities to help your patients get back in the GAME

Introducing the **TendoNova Ocelot Nano**: This device uses a rapidly oscillating stainless-steel
cutter to debride and fragment scar tissue in tendons. The process boosts blood flow, releases
growth factors, and promotes healthy tendon repair and remodeling. It utilizes a delivery mechanism
where biologics can be applied directly to the site, boosting blood flow.

## Why Ocelot Nano?
* Safe and Easy to use
* Decreased cost of care
* Improved patient experience
* Portable, handheld and battery powered

high concentrations of platelets, growth factors, leukocytes, neutrophils, monocytes, and cytokines.
It stands out with elevated red blood cell levels and a hematocrit range of 25–45%.

EmCyte's PurePRP® GS60 Pure II kits offer the only PRP system with multiple processing protocols,
delivering 4–10 mL of clinically effective PRP. These kits produce PRP with minimal red blood cells
and neutrophils, jump-starting the healing cascade for optimal cell remodeling.

PureBMC® is the ultimate solution for Bone Marrow Cell Concentrate, offering a closed, sterile
processing system for enhanced performance. Designed for precision, it enables accurate collection
of high-therapeutic cell concentrates with minimal red blood cell content, optimizing outcomes.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

### Techniques Inspired by the World

## Results Inspired by You

## A Global Approach to Beauty

[ Book Now ][129]

Aère Aesthetics was built on the simple yet overlooked truth that beauty isn’t defined by a single
standard. It’s shaped by culture, heritage, perception, and evolution.

Our approach draws from advanced aesthetic techniques from around the world, including the
scientific rigor of Korean skincare, the structural refinement of Persian aesthetics, and the
injectable and energy treatments of the California coast.

### Continue Reading

With this global perspective, our providers design treatments that honor your background,
preferences, and natural proportions. Every recommendation reflects a broader understanding of how
different cultures view beauty, expression, and aging. Whether you’re seeking soft refinement or
structural support, we select and deliver the global modalities that align with *your* beauty
ideals… all under one roof.

[Group of women in stylish beige outfits.]

## Aère Aesthetics Team

Setting the Global Standards of Aesthetic Care

## Elevated care rooted in safety, precision, and authenticity.

[ Meet the team ][130]

At Aère Aesthetics, our providers offer a higher standard of care as industry educators, national
trainers, and aesthetic experts dedicated to delivering refined, natural-looking results.

Each team member brings advanced medical knowledge, a comprehensive understanding of facial balance,
and a commitment to culturally informed beauty. Together, they collaborate on personalized treatment
plans designed around your anatomy, goals, and aesthetic preferences.

### Continue Reading

With specialties ranging from ultrasound-guided injections to regenerative treatments and global
technique integration, the Aère team ensures every patient receives thoughtful, elevated care rooted
in safety, precision, and authenticity.

### Our Founder

## The Vision Behind Aère

Aère Aesthetics was founded by **Neekan Rivera, PA-C**, a nationally recognized aesthetic expert
known for her refined technique, advanced training, and thoughtful approach to beauty.

With accolades such as *Top 30 Women in Aesthetics* and *Best Injectors in America Top 100*, Neekan
helped shape Aère into a destination for elevated, natural cosmetic care.

### Continue Reading

While she continues to guide the clinical philosophy, Neekan has expanded the practice beyond
herself, building a team that reflects her commitment to safety, precision, and culturally informed
aesthetics. Her exposure to global beauty ideals informs Aère’s internationally inspired treatment
approach.

Today, Neekan leads Aère as a mentor, educator, and industry voice, ensuring that every patient
receives care rooted in expertise, integrity, and a shared dedication to subtle, full-face balance.

### Featured Services

## Overview

Aère Aesthetics specializes in cosmetic treatments that enhance your own beauty, rejuvenate your
youthful glow, and slow the signs of aging. Our trusted staff put together individualized sessions
that provide the highest quality treatments for every client. We are passionate about creating
effective and natural results that achieve your aesthetic goals. We are also routinely advancing our
skills in aesthetic medicine by seeking out training opportunities to ensure that you’re getting the
latest treatments and the best results every time.

Aère Aesthetics services are now available in Los Angeles, Vail, and Denver!

[ Learn More ][135]

### Smooth Expression, Naturally Dynamic

## Botox, Dysport & Daxxify

Neurotoxin treatments at Aère are designed to soften lines while preserving natural facial
expression. Using advanced techniques, including ultrasound guidance when appropriate, our providers
tailor dosing to your anatomy for results that look refreshed, never frozen. Whether you’re
addressing forehead lines, crow’s feet, or areas of tension, neurotoxins work to relax overactive
muscles and create a smoother, more balanced appearance. Treatment plans are fully personalized,
supporting both immediate refinement and long-term prevention as part of a holistic, full-face
approach.

[ Botox, Dysport & Daxxify ][136]

### Restore and More

## Dermal Fillers

We offer a full range of dermal fillers to restore volume, refine contours, and support facial
balance with subtle, natural-looking results. Our providers specialize in full-face assessment,
ensuring every treatment considers proportion, structure, and the unique qualities of your features.
With options ranging from hyaluronic acid fillers to biostimulatory products, each plan is tailored
to your goals and anatomy. Ultrasound guidance enhances safety and precision, while globally
inspired techniques help create refined definition and long-lasting harmony. The result is soft,
cohesive rejuvenation that feels like you — elevated.

[ Dermal Fillers ][137]

### Thoughtful Enhancement

## Lip Fillers

Lip filler treatments at Aère focus on enhancing shape, structure, and balance rather than creating
dramatic or oversized volume. Our providers analyze your natural proportions and cultural beauty
preferences, designing results that complement your facial features. Using advanced techniques and
premium hyaluronic acid fillers, we improve definition, hydration, and symmetry with a soft, natural
finish. Whether you prefer a subtle lift, restored fullness, or refined contouring, every result is
intentionally understated to preserve your natural expression and identity.

[ Lip Fillers ][138]

## Results Inspired by You

## A Global Approach to Beauty

[ Book Now ][129]

Aère Aesthetics was built on the simple yet overlooked truth that beauty isn’t defined by a single
standard. It’s shaped by culture, heritage, perception, and evolution.

Our approach draws from advanced aesthetic techniques from around the world, including the
scientific rigor of Korean skincare, the structural refinement of Persian aesthetics, and the
injectable and energy treatments of the California coast.

### Continue Reading

With this global perspective, our providers design treatments that honor your background,
preferences, and natural proportions. Every recommendation reflects a broader understanding of how
different cultures view beauty, expression, and aging. Whether you’re seeking soft refinement or
structural support, we select and deliver the global modalities that align with *your* beauty
ideals… all under one roof.

Setting the Global Standards of Aesthetic Care

At Aère Aesthetics, our providers offer a higher standard of care as industry educators, national
trainers, and aesthetic experts dedicated to delivering refined, natural-looking results.

Each team member brings advanced medical knowledge, a comprehensive understanding of facial balance,
and a commitment to culturally informed beauty. Together, they collaborate on personalized treatment
plans designed around your anatomy, goals, and aesthetic preferences.

### Continue Reading

With specialties ranging from ultrasound-guided injections to regenerative treatments and global
technique integration, the Aère team ensures every patient receives thoughtful, elevated care rooted
in safety, precision, and authenticity.

### Our Founder

## The Vision Behind Aère

Aère Aesthetics was founded by **Neekan Rivera, PA-C**, a nationally recognized aesthetic expert
known for her refined technique, advanced training, and thoughtful approach to beauty.

With accolades such as *Top 30 Women in Aesthetics* and *Best Injectors in America Top 100*, Neekan
helped shape Aère into a destination for elevated, natural cosmetic care.

### Continue Reading

While she continues to guide the clinical philosophy, Neekan has expanded the practice beyond
herself, building a team that reflects her commitment to safety, precision, and culturally informed
aesthetics. Her exposure to global beauty ideals informs Aère’s internationally inspired treatment
approach.

Today, Neekan leads Aère as a mentor, educator, and industry voice, ensuring that every patient
receives care rooted in expertise, integrity, and a shared dedication to subtle, full-face balance.

addressing forehead lines, crow’s feet, or areas of tension, neurotoxins work to relax overactive

finish. Whether you prefer a subtle lift, restored fullness, or refined contouring, every result is
intentionally understated to preserve your natural expression and identity.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

# Convening the Cell and Gene Therapy Community

ARM unites the cell and gene therapy ecosystem to modernize healthcare systems, overcome obstacles
to innovation, and improve patient access to life-changing treatments.

[ Join ARM ][119]
[Hero Illustration] [Mobile Hero Illustration]

## Uniting Innovators in Cell and Gene Therapy

ARM is where the CGT sector converges to solve its most pressing challenges. We unite a
multistakeholder community of biotechnology companies, research institutions, patient advocates, and
strategic suppliers to shape regulation and policy, unlock access, and accelerate transformative
therapies.

[ Learn More About ARM ][120]
[Cell, gene, and tissue-based therapeutics]

### Cell, gene, and tissue-based therapeutics

We support our members in advancing living medicines that target the root causes of
disease—therapies that repair or replace cells and genes to durably treat and potentially cure a
wide range of conditions.

[Data that drives the sector forward]

### Data that drives the sector forward

Our data and reports track the global pipeline, clinical trials, regulatory shifts, and funding
trends, giving the CGT community and our stakeholders the insight needed to make informed, strategic
decisions.

## ARM Applauds Passage of the Mikaela Naylon Give Kids a Chance Act and the Accelerating Kids
## Access to Care Act

These policies, which became law with President Trump’s signature, represent hope for the rare
disease community and will meaningfully improve access to life-changing and life-saving treatments.

## procedures

Alocuro provides a comprehensive portfolio of medical devices, equipment & advanced training to
support clinicians for reliable preparation of patient-customised PRP and PRF.

Our systems are engineered to deliver autologous platelet preparations customised to each patient
with high-level purity, precision, control and clinical confidence.

ARTG-listed medical technology enables clinicians to consistently harness the regenerative potential
of the patient’s own biology, while minimising variability and inefficiency.

Built for modern clinical practice, Alocuro PRP supports a wide range of regenerative medicine
applications through standardised processing, flexible protocols and reproducible outcomes.

5 device sizes, 90% platelet collection efficiency, adjustable leukocyte inclusion, and a closed
sterile workflow provides clinician control to ensure the patient’s platelet collection matches
their clinical indication and treatment scope.

Visible platelets during every PRP collection provides confidence for clinicians of the sample’s
high platelet concentration, purity and customised precision.

## Why choose Alocuro medical devices?
1. **Clinician onboarding and support:** expert training, protocols, and implementation guidance for
   your practice and indication areas to optimise patient outcomes.
2. **ARTG-listed system:** designed for point-of-care PRP & PRF preparation, consistent platelet
   collection efficiency of 90%, after a 5 minute, single-spin centrifugation.
3. **Five platelet-concentrating device sizes:** 10ml, 15ml, 20ml, 30ml and 60ml, allowing
   customisable platelet dose, concentration and total PRP/PRF volume, tailored to the patient’s
   indication and treatment area.
4. **Adjustable leukocyte inclusion:** to support both leukocyte-reduced and leukocyte-rich PRP
   formulations, depending on the clinical application.

   clinicians to confidently verify the system’s delivery of 90% platelet collection efficiency.
6. **High platelet recovery (average ~90%):** supported by independent pathology testing (summary
   available). This level of reproducibility allows practitioners to reliably match platelet dose to
   clinical indication, and improve outcomes in tissue repair and recovery.
7. **Customisable output control:** to match treatment scope, including platelet dose, leukocyte
   content, plasma volume and resting or activated platelets.
8. **Clinical education pathways:** across all major practice areas, with ongoing training support
   and exclusive resources delivered via the Alocuro Clinician Portal.

under the care of a supervising medical or dental practitioner.

Clinicians who use Alocuro PRO-PRP devices have completed platelet-concentrating processing and

# FAQ’s
* #### Who can buy Alocuro PRP medical devices?
  
  Within Australia, in accordance with TGA regulation of PRP (blood and blood products), Alocuro
  will only sell a PRP system, PRP kits and procedural training to medical, dental practitioners and
  clinical research facilities. Registered nurses or nurse practitioners who are working with an
  Alocuro trained medical practitioner who will provide professional supervision of the PRP
  procedure and who will be responsible for patient care are also supplied. We are unable to supply
  all other health practitioners  or non-health practitioners - in line with the general TGA
  regulation of PRP procedures within Australia.
* #### What does PRP stand for?
  
  PRP is an abbreviation for Platelet Rich Plasma. Plasma is the liquid portion of blood which
  houses all the cellular components such as red and white blood cells, as well as platelets. PRP is
  simply plasma rich in platelets.
* #### What is PRP therapy?
  
  PRP is a non-surgical treatment to aid healing - used in many fields, including sports medicine
  and orthopaedics. In the field of non-surgical orthopaedics, PRP is injected into the affected
  region to stimulate and enhance cellular regeneration. PRP is a small portion of the patient's own
  blood that contains large doses of the body’s healing proteins that are stored in platelets. The
  medical term for these proteins is ‘Growth Factors’.
* #### What types of conditions are treated with PRP?
  
  Based on current research, the following areas have been proven to be most responsive to PRP:
  
  **orthopaedic and sports related processes:** tendonitis, tendinosis, partial tendon tears,
  ligament sprains or partial tears, and partial muscle tears that have not improved after
  conservative treatment - physiotherapy protocols, rest etc. PRP has also been effective at
  treating inflamed synovium and some areas of cartilage found in early to moderate
  osteoarthritis. PRP has been proven by many high quality clinical trials to reduce pain and
  improve joint function for osteoarthritic joints - especially knees.
  
  **dermatology**: healing of skin wounds - acute traumatic and chronic, hard to heal wounds;
  cosmetic skin rejuvenation and scar minimisation
  
  **hair: ** hair restoration in male and female pattern baldness, hair regrowth in auto-immune hair
  loss disorders
  
  **surgical :** multiple surgical applications to assist wound, bone, muscle, tendon , ligament
  healing
  
  **dental:** used with implants and for treating advanced periodontal disease.
* #### Is PRP new?
  
  Platelet Rich Plasma was first used in cardiac surgery in 1987 after an open heart operation to
  avoid blood transfusion. The next area in medicine to adopt the therapy was dental surgery where
  it has been safely used for over 20 years. More recently it has been utilised in plastic surgery,
  cardiothoracic surgery, implant surgery, and spinal fusion surgery. Latest advancements in
  technology have allowed the positive outcomes from these intra-operative applications to be
  replicated in the outpatient clinic setting. Incorporation of latest PRP research into clinical
  practice in the fields of orthopaedic, musculoskeletal, dermatology and wound healing applications
  has provided excellent non-surgical patient management with positive outcomes.
  
  Alocuro is continually reviewing cutting-edge research, and observational data through clinical
  use to ensure that Alocuro’s PRP therapy protocols offer the patient the best possible outcome
  from PRO-PRP.

   collection efficiency of 90%, after a 5 minute, single-spin centrifugation.
3. **Five platelet-concentrating device sizes:** 10ml, 15ml, 20ml, 30ml and 60ml, allowing
   customisable platelet dose, concentration and total PRP/PRF volume, tailored to the patient’s
   indication and treatment area.
4. **Adjustable leukocyte inclusion:** to support both leukocyte-reduced and leukocyte-rich PRP
   formulations, depending on the clinical application.
5. **Closed, sterile, gel-free workflow:** with visible platelets every collection, allowing
   clinicians to confidently verify the system’s delivery of 90% platelet collection efficiency.
6. **High platelet recovery (average ~90%):** supported by independent pathology testing (summary
   available). This level of reproducibility allows practitioners to reliably match platelet dose to
   clinical indication, and improve outcomes in tissue repair and recovery.
7. **Customisable output control:** to match treatment scope, including platelet dose, leukocyte
   content, plasma volume and resting or activated platelets.
8. **Clinical education pathways:** across all major practice areas, with ongoing training support
   and exclusive resources delivered via the Alocuro Clinician Portal.

View fullsize [Alocuro PRP device workflow showing centrifugation, visual platelet layer
identification and preparation of autologous platelet rich plasma in a sterile closed system]

## Advancing healing, tissue repair and recovery through next-generation ‘platelet-concentrating’
## systems

Alocuro’s technology delivers reproducible, evidence-based, and clinically validated outcomes by
ensuring platelet dose consistently meets the target therapeutic threshold.

Through its commitment to research, clinical training, and scientific support, Alocuro is advancing
‘autologous regenerative medicine’ ARM procedures in Australia & New Zealand, empowering clinicians
to deliver effective, patient-customised treatment.

View fullsize [Patented high quality PRP system Australia]
View fullsize [Best PRP and PRF device for platelet collection and patient outcomes]

Alocuro ARTG-listed, WAND-notified and CE registered medical devices are supplied to medical and
dental practitioners and eligible clinical research facilities in accordance with Australian & New
Zealand legislated requirements for autologous blood-component procedures. Registered nurses and
nurse practitioners may perform procedures within their insured scope of practice, when patient is
under the care of a supervising medical or dental practitioner.

Clinicians who use Alocuro PRO-PRP devices have completed platelet-concentrating processing and
injection training, specific to their clinical treatments.

Information on this website is intended for healthcare professionals.

# FAQ’s
* #### Who can buy Alocuro PRP medical devices?
  
  Within Australia, in accordance with TGA regulation of PRP (blood and blood products), Alocuro
  will only sell a PRP system, PRP kits and procedural training to medical, dental practitioners and
  clinical research facilities. Registered nurses or nurse practitioners who are working with an
  Alocuro trained medical practitioner who will provide professional supervision of the PRP
  procedure and who will be responsible for patient care are also supplied. We are unable to supply
  all other health practitioners  or non-health practitioners - in line with the general TGA
  regulation of PRP procedures within Australia.
* #### What does PRP stand for?
  
  PRP is an abbreviation for Platelet Rich Plasma. Plasma is the liquid portion of blood which
  houses all the cellular components such as red and white blood cells, as well as platelets. PRP is
  simply plasma rich in platelets.
* #### What is PRP therapy?
  
  PRP is a non-surgical treatment to aid healing - used in many fields, including sports medicine
  and orthopaedics. In the field of non-surgical orthopaedics, PRP is injected into the affected
  region to stimulate and enhance cellular regeneration. PRP is a small portion of the patient's own
  blood that contains large doses of the body’s healing proteins that are stored in platelets. The
  medical term for these proteins is ‘Growth Factors’.
* #### What types of conditions are treated with PRP?
  
  Based on current research, the following areas have been proven to be most responsive to PRP:
  
  **orthopaedic and sports related processes:** tendonitis, tendinosis, partial tendon tears,
  ligament sprains or partial tears, and partial muscle tears that have not improved after
  conservative treatment - physiotherapy protocols, rest etc. PRP has also been effective at
  treating inflamed synovium and some areas of cartilage found in early to moderate
  osteoarthritis. PRP has been proven by many high quality clinical trials to reduce pain and
  improve joint function for osteoarthritic joints - especially knees.
  
  **dermatology**: healing of skin wounds - acute traumatic and chronic, hard to heal wounds;
  cosmetic skin rejuvenation and scar minimisation
  
  **hair: ** hair restoration in male and female pattern baldness, hair regrowth in auto-immune hair
  loss disorders
  
  **surgical :** multiple surgical applications to assist wound, bone, muscle, tendon , ligament
  healing
  
  **dental:** used with implants and for treating advanced periodontal disease.
* #### Is PRP new?
  
  Platelet Rich Plasma was first used in cardiac surgery in 1987 after an open heart operation to
  avoid blood transfusion. The next area in medicine to adopt the therapy was dental surgery where
  it has been safely used for over 20 years. More recently it has been utilised in plastic surgery,
  cardiothoracic surgery, implant surgery, and spinal fusion surgery. Latest advancements in
  technology have allowed the positive outcomes from these intra-operative applications to be
  replicated in the outpatient clinic setting. Incorporation of latest PRP research into clinical
  practice in the fields of orthopaedic, musculoskeletal, dermatology and wound healing applications
  has provided excellent non-surgical patient management with positive outcomes.
  
  Alocuro is continually reviewing cutting-edge research, and observational data through clinical
  use to ensure that Alocuro’s PRP therapy protocols offer the patient the best possible outcome
  from PRO-PRP.

# MOVING IN UNISON

We work as a flexible, attentive extension of your team; we offer the contract research organization
services you need to move your molecule from preclinical to Phase I, Phase II, and beyond.

[ Contact Us ][14]

[play brand video ][15] [pause brand video ][16]
[5 Strategies to Reduce AI Hallucination in Clinical Research by Seong min Cho]

#### 5 Strategies to Reduce AI Hallucination in Clinical Research by Seong min Cho

Learn 5 practical strategies to reduce AI hallucination in clinical research to improve accuracy,
transparency, compliance, and decision-making.

[Read now! ][17]

[A Day in the Life of A Molecule]

#### A Day in the Life of A Molecule

Press play to meet Mike the Molecule—he’s got big dreams and a big journey ahead! Follow along as he
takes on every stage of drug development here at Altasciences.Science has never been this fun!

[Learn more! ][18]

[A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology]

#### A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

## WHAT WE DO

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.
* [ [Preclinical Services] ][20]

  Safety assessments for both small and large molecules
* [ [Clinical Services] ][22]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Clinical Services ][23]
  
  Clinical pharmacology trials from first-in-human to end of Phase II
* [ [Manufacturing and Analytical Services] ][24]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Manufacturing and Analytical Services ][25]
  
  From formulation development, Phase I through commercial manufacturing, and ICH stability testing
* [ [thumb] ][26]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Bioanalysis Services ][27]
  
  Package or stand-alone. Preclinical, Phase I to Phase IV bioanalytical laboratories
* [ [research support services] ][28]

  Comprehensive CRO services to support clinical and preclinical studies

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Follow us and keep up to date

# We Are
# Andrews Sports Medicine

## Victory Over Injury

From our homebase in Birmingham, AL, we are here for patients from our local community, from the
state of Alabama, across the United States and from around the world. As respected industry leaders,
we are here working hard for you. We are here utilizing the most-advanced technology, to develop
ground-breaking surgical techniques in an effort to provide you with excellence in sports medicine,
and orthopaedic patient care, excellence in research and education and excellence in sports injury
prevention.

demonstrating consistent platelet recovery, customizable PRP formulations, and significant red blood

## Regenerative Medicine Solutions

FDA-registered Class II PRP system engineered for precision and performance


APEX Biologix offers a comprehensive portfolio of FDA-registered Class II autologous biologic
systems, including Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP), Protein Concentrate (A2M), and Bone Marrow
Concentrate (BMC). Engineered for precision, efficiency, and reproducibility, XCELL platforms are
designed to optimize biologic yield, streamline processing, and reduce variability while supporting
advanced regenerative medicine applications across orthopedics, sports medicine, interventional
pain, integrative care, and aesthetics.

## **Frequently Asked Questions About Scheduling**

**Q: How quickly can I be seen?**

A: Most patients are scheduled within one to two business days. For new acute injuries that need
same-day evaluation, we offer walk-in Immediate Injury Care at our Newburg Road campus in
Louisville.

**Q: Do I need a referral?**

A: Most patients can self-refer. Some insurance plans (particularly HMOs and certain Medicare
Advantage plans) require a referral — call 502-430-3689 to confirm your plan's requirements before
scheduling.

**Q: What insurance plans do you accept?**

A: Aptiva accepts most major commercial plans, Medicare, Medicare Advantage, and workers'
compensation. Specific plan participation can vary by provider. Call [1-844-999-3627 (DOCS)][127] to
verify your plan before your visit.

**Q: What should I bring to my first appointment?**

A: Your insurance card, a photo ID, a list of current medications, and any prior records or imaging
related to your concern. We'll send you new patient paperwork in advance.

**Q: How long is a new patient appointment?**

A: New patient evaluations typically run 45-60 minutes. Follow-up visits are usually 15-30 minutes.

**Q: Can I be seen via telehealth?**

A: Yes, telehealth is available for many of our services — particularly Mental Wellness, follow-up
visits, and medication management. Some services (new orthopedic evaluations, physical therapy,
imaging) need to be in-person. Call to discuss which works for your situation.

**Q: How do I prepare for my appointment?**

A: Complete your [new patient paperwork][128] before you arrive. Wear comfortable clothes that allow
easy examination of the area of concern. Plan to arrive 10-15 minutes early for paperwork
verification.

**Q: What if I need to reschedule or cancel?**

A: Call [**1-844-999-3627**][129]** **at least 24 hours in advance to reschedule or cancel without a
fee.
