## **Frequently Asked Questions About Scheduling**

**Q: How quickly can I be seen?**

A: Most patients are scheduled within one to two business days. For new acute injuries that need
same-day evaluation, we offer walk-in Immediate Injury Care at our Newburg Road campus in
Louisville.

**Q: Do I need a referral?**

A: Most patients can self-refer. Some insurance plans (particularly HMOs and certain Medicare
Advantage plans) require a referral — call 502-430-3689 to confirm your plan's requirements before
scheduling.

**Q: What insurance plans do you accept?**

A: Aptiva accepts most major commercial plans, Medicare, Medicare Advantage, and workers'
compensation. Specific plan participation can vary by provider. Call [1-844-999-3627 (DOCS)][127] to
verify your plan before your visit.

**Q: What should I bring to my first appointment?**

A: Your insurance card, a photo ID, a list of current medications, and any prior records or imaging
related to your concern. We'll send you new patient paperwork in advance.

**Q: How long is a new patient appointment?**

A: New patient evaluations typically run 45-60 minutes. Follow-up visits are usually 15-30 minutes.

**Q: Can I be seen via telehealth?**

A: Yes, telehealth is available for many of our services — particularly Mental Wellness, follow-up
visits, and medication management. Some services (new orthopedic evaluations, physical therapy,
imaging) need to be in-person. Call to discuss which works for your situation.

**Q: How do I prepare for my appointment?**

A: Complete your [new patient paperwork][128] before you arrive. Wear comfortable clothes that allow
easy examination of the area of concern. Plan to arrive 10-15 minutes early for paperwork
verification.

**Q: What if I need to reschedule or cancel?**

A: Call [**1-844-999-3627**][129]** **at least 24 hours in advance to reschedule or cancel without a
fee.

# World Leaders in Regenerative, Sports & Longevity Medicine

Helping you feel, move, and live better - without unnecessary surgeries or medications.

## We See Health Differently

Dr. Matt Cook is a global thought leader and innovator in [regenerative medicine][49]. With over 20
years dedicated to advancing functional and regenerative treatments, he has developed a proprietary
multimodal approach that harnesses the body's natural healing power to address complex injuries and
cellular-level regeneration. All of our practitioners have trained under his guidance, ensuring you
receive precision medicine tailored to you.

For too long, medicine has focused on treating symptoms instead of finding solutions. At BioReset
Medical, we use [advanced therapies][50] and regenerative treatments to help your body heal from the
inside out. Whether you're dealing with chronic pain, recovering from an injury, or working to
optimize your health, we create a personalized plan that works for you—not just a one-size-fits-all
treatment.

We don’t just treat patients - we teach doctors worldwide. As leaders in [ultrasound-guided
therapies][51] and [regenerative medicine][52], we train physicians through BioReset University,
ensuring that the most effective techniques are shared across the globe.

[Dr. Matt Cook, founder of BioReset Medical.]

**What Is Regenerative Medicine & Concierge Care?

‍**Regenerative medicine uses biologic therapies - like PRP, stem cells, and peptides - to stimulate
your body’s natural healing processes. At BioReset Medical, our concierge model ensures you receive
direct access to world-class specialists, priority scheduling, and fully personalized treatment
plans.
‍

Whether you’re managing chronic pain, recovering from injury, or optimizing healthspan, our team
crafts solutions that address your unique needs - so you can reclaim your mobility, vitality, and
confidence.

**Benefits** **of Regenerative Concierge Care:

- Personalized Precision **Every treatment plan is custom-designed using advanced diagnostics and
one-on-one expert guidance.

**-** **Non-Surgical Relief **Minimally invasive therapies promote tissue regeneration and reduce
pain without the risks of surgery.

**-** **Seamless Concierge Experience **Direct access to specialists, immediate appointment
availability, and holistic support from consultation through recovery.

We are a forward-thinking functional and integrative health and wellness practice who work with men
and women to optimize their health.  Our mission is to give you back your health and your life
through education, empowerment, lifestyle optimization and evidence-based medicine.

## OUR PROCESS

Patients in our practice participate in our proven process. This proprietary system is the
foundation of our program; it isn’t found anywhere else in the world, and is how and why our
patients experience such phenomenal results.

### STEP 1: Advanced Labs

We initiate an extensive lab evaluation. We assess levels of sex hormones, thyroid function, growth
hormone production, diabetes risk, cardiovascular disease risk, and perform various genetic tests.
* Genetics
* Hormones
* Inflammation
* Cardiovascular health
* Diabetes risk

[Get Started][149]

### STEP 2: In-Depth Diagnostics

Beyond taking your vitals, our cutting-edge, in-house diagnostic equipment assesses arterial health,
screens for peripheral artery disease, and measures the electrical activity of your heart. We also
test bone density, measure visceral fat and determine your body composition.
* Body composition
* Bone density
* Arterial health
* ECG
* Overnight sleep study

[Get Started][150]

### STEP 3: Executive Physical

Our Executive Physical is a 4-part, holistic assessment designed to set up a personal program that
targets your health goals, improves your quality of life, and increases your health span. This
consists of: labs & diagnostics, an initial consultation, a cardiovascular assessment, and a
nutrition assessment & consultation.
* Initial consultation
* Cardiovascular analysis
* Sleep analysis
* Nutrition consultation

[Get Started][151]

### STEP 4: Customized Wellness Plan

Our practice truly individualizes care, which is a cornerstone of our practice. From the first
visit, you receive a wellness plan that’s tailored exclusively for you, based on: your health goals,
genetics, labs & diagnostics, and what’s medically appropriate. As you proceed, we add personalized
cardiometabolic and nutritional components as well.
* Adaptable
* Individualized for you
* Influenced by your genetics
* Customized to meet your goals

[Get Started][152]

### STEP 5: Ongoing Support & Wellness

We are committed to and pride ourselves in the extensive support we provide. As a patient, you have
ongoing access to our practice, providers, and network to ensure you reach your goals and optimize
your health. Your customized plan is reassessed, monitored and adjusted during the year, as
necessary.
* Medication and hormone management
* Supplement management
* Nutrition management
* Ongoing support from our team
* Open contact with your providers
* Routine labs to continuously assess your risk

[Get Started][153]

### STEP 1: Advanced Labs

We initiate an extensive lab evaluation. We assess levels of sex hormones, thyroid function, growth
hormone production, diabetes risk, cardiovascular disease risk, and perform various genetic tests.
* Genetics
* Hormones
* Inflammation
* Cardiovascular health
* Diabetes risk

[Get Started][149]

### STEP 2: In-Depth Diagnostics

Beyond taking your vitals, our cutting-edge, in-house diagnostic equipment assesses arterial health,
screens for peripheral artery disease, and measures the electrical activity of your heart. We also
test bone density, measure visceral fat and determine your body composition.
* Body composition
* Bone density
* Arterial health
* ECG
* Overnight sleep study

[Get Started][150]

### STEP 3: Executive Physical

Our Executive Physical is a 4-part, holistic assessment designed to set up a personal program that
targets your health goals, improves your quality of life, and increases your health span. This
consists of: labs & diagnostics, an initial consultation, a cardiovascular assessment, and a
nutrition assessment & consultation.
* Initial consultation
* Cardiovascular analysis
* Sleep analysis
* Nutrition consultation

[Get Started][151]

### STEP 4: Customized Wellness Plan

Our practice truly individualizes care, which is a cornerstone of our practice. From the first
visit, you receive a wellness plan that’s tailored exclusively for you, based on: your health goals,
genetics, labs & diagnostics, and what’s medically appropriate. As you proceed, we add personalized
cardiometabolic and nutritional components as well.
* Adaptable
* Individualized for you
* Influenced by your genetics
* Customized to meet your goals

[Get Started][152]

### STEP 5: Ongoing Support & Wellness

We are committed to and pride ourselves in the extensive support we provide. As a patient, you have
ongoing access to our practice, providers, and network to ensure you reach your goals and optimize
your health. Your customized plan is reassessed, monitored and adjusted during the year, as
necessary.
* Medication and hormone management
* Supplement management
* Nutrition management
* Ongoing support from our team
* Open contact with your providers
* Routine labs to continuously assess your risk

[Get Started][153]

Before PRP manufacturing, the tube and the rubber plug also need to be cleaned. Glass tubes need to

## **PRP Tube Production Process**

The PRP tube production process is critical to ensure the quality and consistency of the PRP tubes
used in PRP therapy. The following steps are typically involved in the production of PRP tubes:



**Material Selection**: The materials used in the production of PRP tubes are carefully selected to
ensure that they are of high quality and free from contaminants.



**Tube Molding: **The PRP tubes are molded using precise molds that ensure consistency in size and
shape.



**Separation Gel:** The separation gel is added to the tube to ensure optimal separation of the
blood components during centrifugation.



**Anticoagulant: **The appropriate anticoagulant is added to the tube to prevent clotting during the
collection process.



**Sterilization:** The PRP tubes are sterilized using validated methods to ensure that they are free
from contaminants.



**Quality Control:** The PRP tubes undergo rigorous quality control checks to ensure that they meet
the required specifications for use in PRP therapy.



**Conclusion**

The quality of the PRP tube used in the preparation of PRP is critical to the success of PRP
therapy. The PRP tube must be made from high-quality materials, designed to facilitate optimal
separation of blood components, and sterile to prevent contamination of the PRP sample. The PRP tube
production process must be carefully controlled to ensure that the tubes meet the required
specifications for use in PRP therapy. By evaluating the quality of PRP tubes and ensuring a robust
production process, practitioners can maximize the effectiveness of PRP therapy and promote healing
and tissue regeneration in their patients.

and AdvancedMedicine.ca (Functional Medicine/ Neuroplasticity therapies).

Fibromyalgia is a chronic widespread pain condition that affects 3.3% of the Canadian population. It
is difficult to treat as there is no one “magic bullet” like using penicillin for infections.

Platelet-Rich Plasma involves taking blood out, centrifuging it down from Arthrex Angel Technologies
and/or Harvest (Ternmo) and using the plasma which has concentrated platelets for healing. The PRP
concentration of platelets is 5-6x that of regular blood.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."

to make their calls?

DrugPatentWatch pulls directly from primary sources — the USPTO, FDA Orange Book, ANDA filings,
litigation records, patent registers across 134 countries. **Every source an analyst would use.

**Frequently Asked Questions** Your queries answered
What is ExpiredDomains.com?
ExpiredDomains.com is a free online platform that helps users find valuable expired and expiring
domain names. It aggregates domain data from hundreds of top-level domains (TLDs) and displays them
in a searchable, filterable format. Whether you’re seeking domains with SEO authority, existing
traffic, or strong brand potential, the platform provides tools and insights to support smarter
decisions.
Is there a cost to use the platform?
No, the platform is completely free to use. You can browse listings, view metrics, and apply filters
without needing to sign up or pay any fees. There are no hidden charges or usage restrictions.
Can I register domains directly through the site?
No, ExpiredDomains.com does not register domains itself. Instead, it connects you to trusted
external registrars and marketplaces like GoDaddy. You’ll be directed to complete your purchase or
place a bid through their platform.
How often is the domain data updated?
The domain data is updated daily to ensure you're always seeing the most current listings, prices,
and metrics. This includes newly expired domains, auction updates, and fresh insights from

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are

  ### Forward integration for DC

  ### 40% Domestic India Market Share in Paracetamol API

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are

* [icon]
  
  ### Having presence in 65+ countries
* [icon]
  
  ### Backwardly integrated for PAP
* [icon]
  
  ### Forward integration for DC
* [icon]
  
  ### Only Paracetamol Manufacturer with RC Logo (2023)
* [icon]
  
  ### 23% Global Market Share in API Paracetamol
* [icon]
  
  ### 40% Domestic India Market Share in Paracetamol API

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

### Paracetamol DC Granules – Directly Compressible for Tablet Production

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

### New APIs – Theophylline, Rivaroxaban, Folic Acid & More

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

EU GMP Certified, 600 MT/Month

# What is GFC PRP?

**GFC PRP (Growth Factor Concentrated Platelet-Rich Plasma)** represents an advanced evolution of
conventional PRP therapy. This sophisticated system isolates and concentrates platelet-derived
growth factors while systematically minimizing inflammatory cells, delivering a cell-free, highly
bioactive injectable solution.

The technology achieves superior regenerative outcomes through precision processing, making it the
preferred choice for discerning medical practitioners seeking predictable, reproducible clinical
results.

#### Higher Growth Factor Concentration

Enhanced regenerative potential

#### Reduced Inflammation

Improved patient comfort

#### Extended Activity

Longer biological effectiveness

Manufacturing Excellence

# Our GFC PRP Manufacturing Technology

As a dedicated PRP and GFC manufacturer, we follow rigorously validated production protocols
engineered for clinical excellence. Our manufacturing facility employs pharmaceutical-grade controls
to ensure every kit meets the highest standards of safety, sterility, and performance.

1

#### Precision Centrifugation Systems

Optimized protocols for platelet separation with minimal cellular trauma, ensuring maximum viability
and growth factor preservation.

2

#### Closed-System Processing

Hermetically sealed systems minimize contamination risk throughout the entire processing workflow,
from collection to final concentrate.

3

#### Standardized Protocols

Validated procedures ensure batch-to-batch consistency, delivering reproducible platelet counts and
growth factor profiles in every kit.

4

#### High Growth Factor Recovery

Maximized extraction of PDGF, VEGF, TGF-β, EGF, and IGF with documented concentration ratios
verified through laboratory analysis.

5

#### Medical-Grade Components

Single-use, sterile components manufactured from USP Class VI materials, eliminating
cross-contamination and ensuring patient safety.

Clinical Applications

# Applications of GFC PRP

Our GFC PRP systems deliver proven regenerative outcomes across diverse medical specialties. Each
application is supported by growing clinical evidence demonstrating efficacy, safety, and patient
satisfaction.

#### Hair Restoration & Trichology

Effective treatment for androgenetic alopecia, diffuse hair loss, and pattern baldness. Stimulates
follicular regeneration and improves hair density.

#### Aesthetic Dermatology

Comprehensive skin rejuvenation, acne scar revision, pigmentation correction, and collagen induction
for natural anti-aging outcomes.

#### Orthopedics & Sports Medicine

Addresses joint pain, osteoarthritis, and accelerates ligament and tendon healing. Reduces recovery
time for athletic injuries.

#### Gynecology & Reproductive Medicine

Supports vaginal rejuvenation, ovarian rejuvenation protocols, and endometrial preparation for
improved fertility outcomes in IVF procedures.

#### Regenerative Medicine

Broad-spectrum tissue repair and cellular regeneration applications including wound healing and
post-surgical recovery enhancement.

Competitive pricing with no intermediaries. Direct access to technical expertise and streamlined

#### Made in India Excellence

International-quality benchmarks with cost advantages. Leveraging India's pharmaceutical

From small clinic orders to large institutional contracts. Flexible production scheduling

#### Custom Branding Options

OEM and private label services available. Build your brand with our proven technology and

#### Clinical Documentation

Products designed exclusively for licensed clinicians. We understand the demands of clinical

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set

## GMP+ Feed Certification scheme

The GMP+ Feed Certification (GMP+ FC) scheme provides internationally recognised standards to
produce safe feed, and a growing set of international standards for sustainable feed.

Go directly to:

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

## Subscribe to our newsletters


At GMP+ International we believe that sharing knowledge is a prerequisite for a safe and sustainable
feed chain. Please sign up for our newsletters with information about our scheme, training
opportunities, sector developments, feed legislation and more. In this way you are always informed.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

## A Better Approach to Pain Management

The doctors at Greater Austin Pain Center take a multidisciplinary approach to pain management,
providing lasting pain relief that's backed by modern research and techniques. We take a friendlier
approach to your pain symptoms and management - any recommendations from our team only come after
thoroughly listening to your medical history and with careful consideration for your wellbeing.
Visit one of our convenient pain clinics in Austin, Kyle, Dripping Springs, or San Marcos today.

## Pain Management in Austin, Kyle, San Marcos and Dripping Springs

At Greater Austin Pain Center, we help minimize pain from multiple causes such as work injuries,
surgeries, and chronic pain conditions, from muscle, skeletal, joint, and nerve damage. Our pain
management techniques will help you find pain relief that lasts. We treat the following chronic pain
conditions in the Austin, TX area.

[Outline of human back with spine highlighted in pink circle.]

### Neck & Back Pain

Patients can seek treatment options from pain doctors for neck pain, back pain, tension headaches,
migraines and other types of pain. Procedures and treatments can be either invasive or non-invasive,
customized to each patient’s history and treatment plan.

[Hand on pink circle icon]

### Arthritis

Relieve joint pain, stiffness, or immobility from arthritis. Greater Austin Pain Center’s pain
doctors work to relieve over one hundred diseases that affect the muscle and skeletal system.

[Illustration of a blue neuron on red pain target.]

### Nerve Pain

We help manage nerve damage and pain symptoms as a result of diabetes, trauma, infection,
alcoholism, chemotherapy, and other nerve damaging diagnoses. Treatment may depend on severity and
underlying cause.

## A Better Approach to Pain Management

The doctors at Greater Austin Pain Center take a multidisciplinary approach to pain management,
providing lasting pain relief that's backed by modern research and techniques. We take a friendlier
approach to your pain symptoms and management - any recommendations from our team only come after
thoroughly listening to your medical history and with careful consideration for your wellbeing.
Visit one of our convenient pain clinics in Austin, Kyle, Dripping Springs, or San Marcos today.

[AAPM logo with a blue medical emblem representing the American Academy of Pain Medicine.][Logo of
the American Society of Anesthesiologists featuring a stylized blue and purple emblem.][ASRA logo
featuring a triangle with "Pain Medicine, Education, Research" text and medical symbols.][Texas
Medical Association logo featuring a red star and bold text.]
[Austin pain clinic exterior, light blue overlay]

## Pain Management in Austin, Kyle, San Marcos and Dripping Springs

At Greater Austin Pain Center, we help minimize pain from multiple causes such as work injuries,
surgeries, and chronic pain conditions, from muscle, skeletal, joint, and nerve damage. Our pain
management techniques will help you find pain relief that lasts. We treat the following chronic pain
conditions in the Austin, TX area.

[Outline of human back with spine highlighted in pink circle.]

### Neck & Back Pain

Patients can seek treatment options from pain doctors for neck pain, back pain, tension headaches,
migraines and other types of pain. Procedures and treatments can be either invasive or non-invasive,
customized to each patient’s history and treatment plan.

[Hand on pink circle icon]

### Arthritis

Relieve joint pain, stiffness, or immobility from arthritis. Greater Austin Pain Center’s pain
doctors work to relieve over one hundred diseases that affect the muscle and skeletal system.

[Illustration of a blue neuron on red pain target.]

### Nerve Pain

We help manage nerve damage and pain symptoms as a result of diabetes, trauma, infection,
alcoholism, chemotherapy, and other nerve damaging diagnoses. Treatment may depend on severity and
underlying cause.

# Design, Manufacturing & Packaging for medical devices & medical instruments

    Hamandi Corp is a Design, Packaging and Manufacturer in the Medical Device section for
healthcare.



In Addition to contract manufacturing work, Hamandi Corp's expertise is in the development of
sterile, single-use blood collection systems for the collection, processing, and preparation of
autologous blood or bone marrow.



We are located in West Palm Beach, Florida and function as a Contract Manufacturing Organization
(CMO). We currently manufacture platelet rich plasma devices, medical instruments and devices,
packaging of medical devices and have some inhouse testing capabilities.

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is the flagship company of Shah Group, founded by Mr. Shah in 1976.
An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

Having three decades of experience, Healthy Life Pharma is a WHO recognized organization, which has
certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

## Formulation & Bulk Drugs

Tablets

Available for variety of applications in different forms such as uncoated, sugar coated, film
coated, chewable and more.

Capsules

Wide range of capsules that are available as antibiotic capsules, pain killer capsules, vitamin
supplements & tonics.

Injectables

# Know who makes what, worldwide

Free, and no account needed. [Or explore a live demo →][7]

Partner-fit criteria

How it works

## Two sides publish. Hell of a Partner matches.

A brand posts the distribution it needs. A distributor posts the capability it offers. Hell of a
Partner scores the fit and brokers the introduction.

Manufacturer / Brand

Publishes a distribution offer
* Product lines to place
* Target markets to reach
* Sales channels to sell through
* Requirements for the right partner

### Hell of a Partner, the platform

It scores every distributor against each brand's offer on seven weighted criteria, then brokers the
introduction. Contact details stay private until the request is accepted.

Distributor / Importer / Agent

Publishes a capability profile
* Markets and territories covered
* Sales channels operated
* Customer base already served
* Product categories handled
* Certifications held

What makes it different

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

[Browse the catalog by category and country →][8]
* Verified at the source
  
  Matched to official business registries (SIREN, CVR, RCCM and dozens more) or protected origin
  marks like PDO, GI and Genuine Jersey, not a self-declared badge.
* Sorted by category and country
  
  Find a specific product in a specific market instead of scrolling an endless, unfiltered list.
* Reachable even without a website
  
  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

Matching engine

## Matching that explains itself

Every distributor is scored 0 to 100 against a manufacturer's offer on seven weighted criteria, with
a plain-language rationale, not a black box.
* 22%
  
  Country coverage
  
  Share of the manufacturer's target markets the distributor actively covers.
* 20%
  
  Category match
  
  Whether the distributor specialises in the offer's product category.
* 16%
  
  Sales channels
  
  Overlap between the requested sales channels and the distributor's channels.
* 13%
  
  Minimum order fit
  
  How comfortably the distributor's order capacity meets the minimum.
* 12%
  
  Certification fit
  
  Required certifications the distributor already holds.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

## Our Customer Testimonials

[Video video]
[5 star]

Roadi T.

4.280 Grafts

FUE
Denmark 🇩🇰

4.280 Grafts

FUE

Denmark 🇩🇰
Using the Unique FUE technique, 4,280 grafts were carefully harvested without overharvesting,
ensuring optimal donor health. For Norwood 5 hair loss, a dense implantation was performed on the
fully bald front area and thickening on the thinning upper region. The vertex was intentionally left
untouched to focus on achieving a natural and sustainable result in the priority zones. With
high-quality grafts averaging 3.2 hairs per follicle, our expert team ensured precise placement for
a balanced and lasting outcome.
[Video video]
[5 star]

Alexander P.

4.280 Grafts

DHI

Germany 🇩🇪

4.280 Grafts

DHI

Germany 🇩🇪

Using the DHI technique, 4,280 grafts were transferred from the scalp donor area to enhance the
naturally sparse beard of a patient due to genetics. The beard was designed according to the
patient’s preferences and facial structure. With moderate graft quality averaging 2.6 hairs per
follicle and moderate root strength, the procedure achieved natural and satisfying results.
[Video video]
[5 star]

Juan C. V.

3.340 Grafts

DHI

U.S.A 🇺🇸

3.340 Grafts

FUE
U.S.A 🇺🇸
Our male client from the USA completed his 9-month DHI hair transplant journey with 3,320 grafts,
each averaging 2.4 hairs. He had Norwood 3 hair loss, with fully bald and thinning areas. Dense
implantation was done on bald spots and thickening on thinning areas. Despite fine grafts, our
expert team ensured precise placement for natural, satisfying results.
[Video video]
[5 star]

Matthew

3.500 Grafts

DHI

Canada 🇨🇦

3.500 Grafts

DHI

Canada 🇨🇦

In this DHI hair transplant performed for a Canadian patient, 3,500 grafts were harvested using a
9–4 punch system. Although the grafts were of medium quality, an impressive average of 3 hairs per
graft significantly boosted overall density. Intensive implantation was applied to reconstruct the
frontal hairline and reinforce the area just behind it. The entire procedure was completed without
complications, and at 10 months, the result shows excellent density, natural direction, and a
balanced appearance—demonstrating the effectiveness of precise technique and graft management.

[Video video]
[5 star]

Andrew

3.150 Grafts

DHI

U.S.A 🇺🇸

3.150 Grafts

DHI

U.S.A 🇺🇸

This 12-month DHI hair transplant result for a patient from the USA demonstrates excellent clinical
planning and execution. A total of 3,510 grafts were used, focusing on dense implantation in the
frontal zone where visible thinning was present. Despite the grafts being of medium quality, the
average hair count per graft was high—around 3 hairs per follicle—contributing significantly to
overall density. Bleeding was minimal, and no complications occurred during or after the procedure.
The outcome reflects precise handling, careful angle control, and optimal graft survival, leading to
a natural and full-looking hairline.

Roadi T.

FUE
Denmark 🇩🇰

4.280 Grafts

FUE

Denmark 🇩🇰
Using the Unique FUE technique, 4,280 grafts were carefully harvested without overharvesting,
ensuring optimal donor health. For Norwood 5 hair loss, a dense implantation was performed on the
fully bald front area and thickening on the thinning upper region. The vertex was intentionally left
untouched to focus on achieving a natural and sustainable result in the priority zones. With
high-quality grafts averaging 3.2 hairs per follicle, our expert team ensured precise placement for
a balanced and lasting outcome.
[Video video]
[5 star]

Alexander P.

4.280 Grafts

DHI

Germany 🇩🇪

4.280 Grafts

DHI

Germany 🇩🇪

Using the DHI technique, 4,280 grafts were transferred from the scalp donor area to enhance the
naturally sparse beard of a patient due to genetics. The beard was designed according to the
patient’s preferences and facial structure. With moderate graft quality averaging 2.6 hairs per
follicle and moderate root strength, the procedure achieved natural and satisfying results.
[Video video]
[5 star]

Juan C. V.

DHI

U.S.A 🇺🇸

3.340 Grafts

FUE
U.S.A 🇺🇸
Our male client from the USA completed his 9-month DHI hair transplant journey with 3,320 grafts,
each averaging 2.4 hairs. He had Norwood 3 hair loss, with fully bald and thinning areas. Dense
implantation was done on bald spots and thickening on thinning areas. Despite fine grafts, our
expert team ensured precise placement for natural, satisfying results.
[Video video]
[5 star]

Matthew

3.500 Grafts

DHI

Canada 🇨🇦

3.500 Grafts

DHI

Canada 🇨🇦

In this DHI hair transplant performed for a Canadian patient, 3,500 grafts were harvested using a
9–4 punch system. Although the grafts were of medium quality, an impressive average of 3 hairs per
graft significantly boosted overall density. Intensive implantation was applied to reconstruct the
frontal hairline and reinforce the area just behind it. The entire procedure was completed without
complications, and at 10 months, the result shows excellent density, natural direction, and a
balanced appearance—demonstrating the effectiveness of precise technique and graft management.

[Video video]
[5 star]

Andrew

DHI

U.S.A 🇺🇸

3.150 Grafts

DHI

U.S.A 🇺🇸

This 12-month DHI hair transplant result for a patient from the USA demonstrates excellent clinical
planning and execution. A total of 3,510 grafts were used, focusing on dense implantation in the
frontal zone where visible thinning was present. Despite the grafts being of medium quality, the
average hair count per graft was high—around 3 hairs per follicle—contributing significantly to
overall density. Bleeding was minimal, and no complications occurred during or after the procedure.
The outcome reflects precise handling, careful angle control, and optimal graft survival, leading to
a natural and full-looking hairline.

## At Hetero, our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of
## life-saving medicines across the world.

With unparalleled strengths in pharmaceutical research, manufacturing, and marketing, we are
positioned to serve people regardless of geographies. Our new identity embodies this drive to expand
our reach and capabilities in order to respond with agility to the world’s evolving health needs.
Our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of life-saving
medicines across the world.

## Partnering with MPP to expand access of nirmatrelvir & ritonavir generics for COVID-19 treatment

To ensure significant increase in access to COVID-19 treatments for all people, particularly those
living in the poorest parts of the world.

## Positive results in Phase III trials of Hetero’s Movfor (Molnupiravir)

Demonstrated that Molnupiravir along with Standard of Care (SOC) reduced the risk of hospitalization

## При крайней необходимости проводим следующие виды операций

01 - Микрохирургическая дискэктомия

Минимально инвазивная операция по удалению грыжи межпозвоночного диска с использованием микроскопа
для уменьшения давления на нервные корешки.

02 - Эндоскопическая дискэктомия

Малоинвазивная процедура удаления грыжи диска с использованием эндоскопа, что минимизирует
травматизацию тканей и ускоряет восстановление

03 - Радиочастотная денервация межпозвонковых суставов

Метод обезболивания, при котором с помощью радиочастотного излучения разрушаются болевые нервы в
области межпозвонковых суставов.

04 - Радиочастотная денервация периферических нервов

Процедура, направленная на снижение боли путем разрушения периферических нервов с использованием
радиочастотного воздействия.

05 - Микрохирургическая декомпрессия корешков спинного мозга при стенозе позвоночного канала

Хирургическое удаление тканей, сужающих позвоночный канал, для уменьшения давления на нервные
корешки

06 - Стабилизация позвоночника

Хирургическое вмешательство для восстановления стабильности позвоночного столба с использованием
имплантов, фиксаторов или костных трансплантатов.

07 - Вертебропластика

Минимально инвазивная процедура, при которой в поврежденный позвонок вводится специальный костный
цемент для укрепления и устранения боли.

08 - Удаление опухоли спинного мозга

Удаление опухолей спинного мозга — это хирургическое вмешательство, направленное на устранение
новообразований, развивающихся в области спинного мозга или его оболочек.

## При крайней необходимости проводим следующие виды операций

01 - Микрохирургическая дискэктомия

Минимально инвазивная операция по удалению грыжи межпозвоночного диска с использованием микроскопа
для уменьшения давления на нервные корешки.

02 - Эндоскопическая дискэктомия

Малоинвазивная процедура удаления грыжи диска с использованием эндоскопа, что минимизирует
травматизацию тканей и ускоряет восстановление

03 - Радиочастотная денервация межпозвонковых суставов

Метод обезболивания, при котором с помощью радиочастотного излучения разрушаются болевые нервы в
области межпозвонковых суставов.

04 - Радиочастотная денервация периферических нервов

Процедура, направленная на снижение боли путем разрушения периферических нервов с использованием
радиочастотного воздействия.

05 - Микрохирургическая декомпрессия корешков спинного мозга при стенозе позвоночного канала

Хирургическое удаление тканей, сужающих позвоночный канал, для уменьшения давления на нервные
корешки

06 - Стабилизация позвоночника

Хирургическое вмешательство для восстановления стабильности позвоночного столба с использованием
имплантов, фиксаторов или костных трансплантатов.

07 - Вертебропластика

Минимально инвазивная процедура, при которой в поврежденный позвонок вводится специальный костный
цемент для укрепления и устранения боли.

08 - Удаление опухоли спинного мозга

Удаление опухолей спинного мозга — это хирургическое вмешательство, направленное на устранение
новообразований, развивающихся в области спинного мозга или его оболочек.

## Памятка пациента

Нужно ли предварительно приезжать на консультацию?
Не обязательно, вы можете в один день проконсультироваться с врачом и сразу сделать процедуру, если
она вам показана.
Как проходит прием?

1. В самом начале врач проводит подробную консультацию и собирает анамнез. Консультация бесплатная.

2. Совместно с пациентом обсуждаются пути решения проблемы и еще раз проговаривается стоимость
лечения.

3. Выполняется процедура.

4. Даются постпроцедурные рекомендации.

Насколько заранее нужно записываться? Могу ли я приехать день в день?

Так как запись плотная, записываться лучше за 5-7 дней. Особенно на длительные процедуры, такие как
SMAS и RF-лифтинг.

Если нужная дата занята, администратор добавит вас в лист ожидания и, при наличии свободных окон,
перенесет запись на более удобное время.

Можно ли просто проконсультироваться с врачом?

Да, вы можете записаться только на консультацию и обсудить с врачом все волнующие вопросы: выяснить,
показана ли конкретная процедура, уточнить диагноз, подобрать домашний уход. Консультация
бесплатная.

Как убедиться в оригинальности оборудования?

Все оборудование в Jolly Clinic имеет регистрационное удостоверение Росздравнадзора. Аппараты
официально ввезены на территорию РФ и находятся на гарантийном и постгарантийном сервисном
обслуживании официальных дистрибьютеров. Эту информацию можно проверить на сайтах партнеров (список
ниже), в разделе «Где пройти процедуру», либо по телефону.

Также на ряд аппаратов есть официальные письма от поставщиков оборудования, можно запросить у
администратора.

Может ли врач отказать в процедуре?

Да, в следующий случаях:
* есть строгие противопоказания (после записи администратор высылает полный список, также с ним
  можно ознакомиться на сайте, внизу страницы с описанием каждой услуги);
* нет показаний к процедуре;
* пациент приезжает с герпесом, простудой или другим инфекционным/вирусным заболеванием (в этом
  случае прием можно перенести на другой день);
* пациент эмоционально нестабилен.

Возможен ли прием пациентов до 18 лет?

Некоторые процедуры, например лечение акне или удаление сосудов, мы выполняем пациентам начиная с 16
лет. В этом случае нужно письменное согласие одного из родителей.

Какая форма оплаты?

Наличные и карта.

Можно ли оформить налоговый вычет?

Да, для этого после приема обратитесь к администратору, и он подготовит пакет документов.

Есть ли парковка?

На территории Бизнес центра парковка не предусмотрена. В шаговой доступности расположено несколько
муниципальных парковок, на них обычно есть свободные места.

## Памятка пациента

Нужно ли предварительно приезжать на консультацию?
Не обязательно, вы можете в один день проконсультироваться с врачом и сразу сделать процедуру, если
она вам показана.
Как проходит прием?

1. В самом начале врач проводит подробную консультацию и собирает анамнез. Консультация бесплатная.

2. Совместно с пациентом обсуждаются пути решения проблемы и еще раз проговаривается стоимость
лечения.

3. Выполняется процедура.

4. Даются постпроцедурные рекомендации.

Насколько заранее нужно записываться? Могу ли я приехать день в день?

Так как запись плотная, записываться лучше за 5-7 дней. Особенно на длительные процедуры, такие как
SMAS и RF-лифтинг.

Если нужная дата занята, администратор добавит вас в лист ожидания и, при наличии свободных окон,
перенесет запись на более удобное время.

Можно ли просто проконсультироваться с врачом?

Да, вы можете записаться только на консультацию и обсудить с врачом все волнующие вопросы: выяснить,
показана ли конкретная процедура, уточнить диагноз, подобрать домашний уход. Консультация
бесплатная.

Как убедиться в оригинальности оборудования?

Все оборудование в Jolly Clinic имеет регистрационное удостоверение Росздравнадзора. Аппараты
официально ввезены на территорию РФ и находятся на гарантийном и постгарантийном сервисном
обслуживании официальных дистрибьютеров. Эту информацию можно проверить на сайтах партнеров (список
ниже), в разделе «Где пройти процедуру», либо по телефону.

Также на ряд аппаратов есть официальные письма от поставщиков оборудования, можно запросить у
администратора.

Может ли врач отказать в процедуре?

Да, в следующий случаях:
* есть строгие противопоказания (после записи администратор высылает полный список, также с ним
  можно ознакомиться на сайте, внизу страницы с описанием каждой услуги);
* нет показаний к процедуре;
* пациент приезжает с герпесом, простудой или другим инфекционным/вирусным заболеванием (в этом
  случае прием можно перенести на другой день);
* пациент эмоционально нестабилен.

Возможен ли прием пациентов до 18 лет?

Некоторые процедуры, например лечение акне или удаление сосудов, мы выполняем пациентам начиная с 16
лет. В этом случае нужно письменное согласие одного из родителей.

Какая форма оплаты?

Наличные и карта.

Можно ли оформить налоговый вычет?

Да, для этого после приема обратитесь к администратору, и он подготовит пакет документов.

Есть ли парковка?

На территории Бизнес центра парковка не предусмотрена. В шаговой доступности расположено несколько
муниципальных парковок, на них обычно есть свободные места.

## India Entry, GTM, M&A and Feasibility, backed by global research.

For global enterprises entering India, and Indian companies expanding across markets and capital.
KAMRIT runs the strategy work alongside the filings. Our sister firm Claight (same directors, same

every recommendation.

1
**India Entry & Feasibility Studies**

Pre-feasibility, market sizing, FDI route, entity selection, regulatory mapping, and 90-180-365 day
operating plan.

2
**GTM Strategy & Channel Architecture**

Six to ten week sprints ending in a binding plan: segment priorities, channel design, P&L, hiring
and regulatory checklist.

3
**M&A, Valuation & Transfer Pricing**

Buy-side and sell-side advisory, registered-valuer reports, transfer pricing studies and 3CEB
filings.

[Plan your India entry][53] [Read GTM playbook][54]
Why KAMRIT

## India's most trusted compliance partner.

15+ years of expertise. Senior-partner accountability. 100% online tracking. No hidden charges.

01

### Senior partner accountability

Every engagement is owned end to end by a partner. No layered teams, no chasing analysts.

02

### Fixed-fee transparent pricing

Published prices for every service. No surprise invoices. Monthly retainers for ongoing compliance.

03

### 100% online delivery

Track applications, documents, and due dates in one dashboard. File from anywhere in India.

04

### India-wide and global

Headquartered in Delhi and Noida, serving clients across India, plus USA, UK, Singapore, and UAE
setup.

How it works

## From enquiry to filing in four steps.

### Tell us what you need

Share a quick description of your business and the service you need. A KAMRIT expert reviews it
within one business day.

### Document review

We send you a precise document checklist. Your dedicated expert reviews everything before any portal
submission.

### Online filing

We file with MCA, GSTN, Income Tax, IPO, RBI, or the relevant authority and track every
notification.

### Approval & ongoing support

You receive your certificate, PAN, GSTIN, or registration number with full digital backup. We stay
on for ongoing compliance.

[Start your filing today][55]
Industries we serve

## Industry-specific advisory across India.

From e-commerce and SaaS to manufacturing and exports, KAMRIT supports businesses across every
industry domain.

[E-commerce & D2C][56] [SaaS & Technology][57] [Manufacturing][58] [Retail & Consumer Goods][59]
[Healthcare & Pharma][60] [Real Estate & Construction][61] [Logistics & Supply Chain][62] [Financial
Services][63] [Education & EdTech][64] [Food & Beverage][65] [Exports & Trading][66] [Agriculture &
Agritech][67] [Energy & Renewables][68] [Automotive][69] [Aerospace & Defence][70] [Media &
Entertainment][71] [Consulting & Professional Services][72]
5+ Years of professional service since 2020
12 Practice areas under one accountable team
100+ Indian and global clients served
4 Office locations: Delhi (HQ), Noida, plus partner offices

## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.
  GST returns from ₹699 a month. Trademark filing at ₹4,899. All fixed fee.
* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.
  GST returns from ₹699 a month. Trademark filing at ₹4,899. All fixed fee.
* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

Welcome to Legacy Aesthetics

Nicollette Guillen, FNP-BC: Lead Injector and Facial Balancing Specialist

Legacy Aesthetics is a high-authority medical spa serving the San Ramon community and the
surrounding East Bay area. We are not a high-volume beauty mill. We are a boutique, appointment-only
practice where every patient receives individualized attention from a clinically trained provider.
Our philosophy is simple: results should be balanced, proportional, and subtle. You should look
refreshed, not different. Whether you are exploring aesthetic treatments for the first time or
looking to correct unsatisfactory work from a previous provider, our team is here to listen, advise,
and deliver outcomes you can trust.

### FREE Complimentary Full Face Consultation

About Legacy Aesthetics

## A Practice Built on Precision, Safety, and the "You, But Better" Philosophy

Legacy Aesthetics was founded on the belief that aesthetic medicine should be practiced with the
same rigor and care as any other medical specialty. Our clinic operates by appointment only within a
boutique setting inside Salons by JC in San Ramon, creating a calm, consultative environment far
removed from the clinical coldness of traditional medical offices or the high-pressure atmosphere of
volume-driven spas. We attract patients who want long-term results, not quick fixes. Our consistent
waitlist reflects the trust our community places in our expertise, and our 5.0 Google rating across
more than 160 verified reviews speaks to the outcomes we deliver every day.

[ ABOUT US ][51]

Our Commitment to You

## What a Patient-First Medical Spa in San Ramon Actually Looks Like

At Legacy Aesthetics, our commitment to patients goes beyond the treatment room. From your first
consultation to your post-care follow-up, we are with you every step of the way. Here is what you
can expect when you choose our San Ramon med spa for your aesthetic care.

[ CALL US ][52]
[Black speech bubble icon with a white medical cross inside]

### Complimentary Full-Face Consultation

Every new patient receives a complimentary, no-pressure full-face consultation. We listen first,
then offer expert recommendations based on your anatomy, goals, and long-term wellness plan.

[Black silhouette of a woman with long hair and sparkle icons on a white background]

### Natural & Subtle Outcomes

We are committed to results that look like you at your best. Our "you, but better" philosophy means
we will never push for an overfilled or exaggerated look. Balance and proportion guide every
treatment decision.

[Black user silhouette with five stars above the head, suggesting a rating or review icon]

### Corrective Expertise

If you have had unsatisfactory work done elsewhere, you are not alone. Nicollette is a trusted
specialist in corrective aesthetics, helping patients restore balance after treatments that did not
go as planned.

[Black heart next to an upright hand icon on a white background]

areas?**

removal for all skin types! Beards, Back, Bums and Balls, we do it all! Our Mansculpt experts are

electro-muscle stimulation. 20,000 contractions in a 45-minute session! Get fitness advice and put
your feet up and relax while our latest technology does all the work.

Say hello to your new gentlemen’s club.

✓ Safe, effective, and non-surgical solutions with clinically proven technologies

✓ Discreet, male-focused environment designed for comfort, privacy, and confidence

## Как выбрать врача?

На работу в клинику персонального здоровья и репродукции «Генезис» попасть непросто. Мы принимаем в
команду только тех специалистов, кто соответствует высоким профессиональным и человеческим
требованиям. Каждый кандидат проходит строгий многоэтапный отбор: мы оцениваем не только опыт и
медицинскую квалификацию, но и ценности, подход к пациенту, умение общаться с уважением и заботой.

В результате — в нашей клинике работают `только проверенные и по-настоящему сильные врачи.`

Поэтому, если вы выбираете специалиста, можете быть уверены: с профессиональной точки зрения любой
врач «Генезис» — надёжный выбор.

## Хочется почувствовать, кто ближе?

У каждого нашего врача на сайте есть видео-визитка, где доктор рассказывает о себе, о подходе к
лечению и своих ценностях. Это поможет заранее понять, с кем вам будет комфортнее взаимодействовать.

## А если врач не подошёл?

Иногда так бывает — и это абсолютно нормально. Даже очень хороший специалист может не совпасть с
вами по стилю общения или энергетике.

Если вы чувствуете, что контакт не сложился, просто сообщите нам на ресепшн или напишите на
[info@mcgenesis.ru][261]

Мы без драмы и неудобных разговоров подберём другого врача, с которым вы почувствуете себя спокойно
и уверенно.

## «ГЕНЕЗИС»

Изучая информацию о клиниках, специализирующихся на лечении бесплодия и искусственном
оплодотворении, будьте внимательны к деталям и репутации учреждений, ведь это вопрос нового этапа в
жизни Вашей семьи.
О центре «Генезис»
Процедура ЭКО в центре репродукции «Генезис» - это Ваша возможность стать родителями, когда другие
методы лечения бесплодия неэффективны!
Центр планирования семьи и репродуктологии «Генезис» дает реальный шанс на материнство при
бесплодии. Высокая результативность процедур ВРТ достигается благодаря современному оснащению

## Как выбрать врача?

На работу в клинику персонального здоровья и репродукции «Генезис» попасть непросто. Мы принимаем в
команду только тех специалистов, кто соответствует высоким профессиональным и человеческим
требованиям. Каждый кандидат проходит строгий многоэтапный отбор: мы оцениваем не только опыт и
медицинскую квалификацию, но и ценности, подход к пациенту, умение общаться с уважением и заботой.

В результате — в нашей клинике работают `только проверенные и по-настоящему сильные врачи.`

Поэтому, если вы выбираете специалиста, можете быть уверены: с профессиональной точки зрения любой
врач «Генезис» — надёжный выбор.

## Хочется почувствовать, кто ближе?

У каждого нашего врача на сайте есть видео-визитка, где доктор рассказывает о себе, о подходе к
лечению и своих ценностях. Это поможет заранее понять, с кем вам будет комфортнее взаимодействовать.

## А если врач не подошёл?

Иногда так бывает — и это абсолютно нормально. Даже очень хороший специалист может не совпасть с
вами по стилю общения или энергетике.

Если вы чувствуете, что контакт не сложился, просто сообщите нам на ресепшн или напишите на
[info@mcgenesis.ru][261]

Мы без драмы и неудобных разговоров подберём другого врача, с которым вы почувствуете себя спокойно
и уверенно.
