## FAQ

Are the hospitals and clinics in Vietnam safe and modern?

Yes. We work only with top-rated hospitals and clinics that meet international standards. Many of
them are certified by JCI or ISO, and equipped with advanced technology and English-speaking staff.

How much can I save by getting treatment in Vietnam?

Patients can save between 30% to 70% compared to treatment costs in the U.S., Australia, or Europe —
without compromising on quality. Vietnam also offers excellent post-operative care and shorter wait
times.

Do I need a visa for medical travel to Vietnam?

Yes, most patients will need a visa. However, MedicalTourism.vn can assist you with visa application
support and provide documentation from your chosen hospital to ease the process.

Will there be someone to help me during my stay?

Absolutely. We provide end-to-end support, including airport pickup, interpreter/translation
services, hospital appointments, hotel and transportation arrangements, and 24/7 patient care
coordination.

Is translation or interpreter service available at MedtourVietnam?

Yes, MedtourVietnam currently offers professional interpretation services in English. We are
actively working to expand our language support. Upcoming languages will include Chinese (Mandarin),
Arabic, French, and Spanish.

How do I get started with MedicalTourism.vn?

It’s easy! Contact us via our website or WhatsApp, share your medical reports, receive a
personalized treatment plan, confirm your arrangements, and arrive in Vietnam for treatment with
full support.

Can I combine medical treatment with vacation?

Yes! Vietnam is a top travel destination. We offer recovery-friendly travel packages so you can
explore Vietnam's beauty before or after your treatment — beaches, mountains, historical cities, and
wellness resorts.

Is medical tourism covered by insurance?

Some international health insurance policies may partially cover procedures abroad. We recommend
contacting your insurance provider directly. We can also help with the documentation needed for
reimbursement claims.

Can I get a free online consultation?

Yes, we offer free initial consultations with our case managers or partner doctors. This helps
assess your condition and recommend the most suitable treatment options before you travel.

Can MedtourVietnam accommodate special dietary or religious requirements?

Yes, MedtourVietnam can accommodate special dietary and religious requirements. We work with
hospitals and hotels to support Halal, vegetarian, gluten-free, or low-sodium meals,
fasting-friendly schedules, and access to prayer rooms upon request.

Are telemedicine or virtual consultations available for international patients?

Yes, MedtourVietnam offers virtual consultations before travel and follow-up video check-ins after
your return. These help monitor recovery, manage medications, and coordinate with doctors in your
home country.

How can I get a cost estimate for treatment through MedtourVietnam?

Send us your medical records via our website or WhatsApp. We'll consult with top hospitals and
provide a detailed estimate within 24–48 hours, covering procedures, hospital stay, interpreter, and
logistics.

What payment methods are accepted through MedtourVietnam?

We accept major credit cards, bank transfers (local & international), cash payments, and direct
billing with select international insurers. Let us know your preferred method and we’ll assist with
invoices or documentation.

What types of medical treatments are most popular among international patients?

Health checkups, orthopedic surgery, fertility care, cardiology, oncology, and cosmetic procedures
are among the most requested services offered through our accredited hospital network.

How does MedtourVietnam ensure patient privacy and confidentiality?

We comply with international data protection standards. All medical records are securely stored and
shared only with authorized professionals, with your full consent, under HIPAA-equivalent
safeguards.

Does MedtourVietnam provide support for post-treatment care?

Yes, we offer in-person hospital follow-ups and virtual support after your return, including
medication management, rehabilitation advice, and coordination with your home doctors.

How can I contact MedtourVietnam for further questions or urgent support?

Our international support team is available 24/7. Contact us via hotline, email, or WhatsApp for any
questions or urgent assistance throughout your treatment journey.

## Still have questions?

Get in touch with us and we’re happy to assist if you did not find the answer to your specific
question yet.

## FAQ

Are the hospitals and clinics in Vietnam safe and modern?

Yes. We work only with top-rated hospitals and clinics that meet international standards. Many of
them are certified by JCI or ISO, and equipped with advanced technology and English-speaking staff.

How much can I save by getting treatment in Vietnam?

Patients can save between 30% to 70% compared to treatment costs in the U.S., Australia, or Europe —
without compromising on quality. Vietnam also offers excellent post-operative care and shorter wait
times.

Do I need a visa for medical travel to Vietnam?

Yes, most patients will need a visa. However, MedicalTourism.vn can assist you with visa application
support and provide documentation from your chosen hospital to ease the process.

Will there be someone to help me during my stay?

Absolutely. We provide end-to-end support, including airport pickup, interpreter/translation
services, hospital appointments, hotel and transportation arrangements, and 24/7 patient care
coordination.

Is translation or interpreter service available at MedtourVietnam?

Yes, MedtourVietnam currently offers professional interpretation services in English. We are
actively working to expand our language support. Upcoming languages will include Chinese (Mandarin),
Arabic, French, and Spanish.

How do I get started with MedicalTourism.vn?

It’s easy! Contact us via our website or WhatsApp, share your medical reports, receive a
personalized treatment plan, confirm your arrangements, and arrive in Vietnam for treatment with
full support.

Can I combine medical treatment with vacation?

Yes! Vietnam is a top travel destination. We offer recovery-friendly travel packages so you can
explore Vietnam's beauty before or after your treatment — beaches, mountains, historical cities, and
wellness resorts.

Is medical tourism covered by insurance?

Some international health insurance policies may partially cover procedures abroad. We recommend
contacting your insurance provider directly. We can also help with the documentation needed for
reimbursement claims.

Can I get a free online consultation?

Yes, we offer free initial consultations with our case managers or partner doctors. This helps
assess your condition and recommend the most suitable treatment options before you travel.

Can MedtourVietnam accommodate special dietary or religious requirements?

Yes, MedtourVietnam can accommodate special dietary and religious requirements. We work with
hospitals and hotels to support Halal, vegetarian, gluten-free, or low-sodium meals,
fasting-friendly schedules, and access to prayer rooms upon request.

Are telemedicine or virtual consultations available for international patients?

Yes, MedtourVietnam offers virtual consultations before travel and follow-up video check-ins after
your return. These help monitor recovery, manage medications, and coordinate with doctors in your
home country.

How can I get a cost estimate for treatment through MedtourVietnam?

Send us your medical records via our website or WhatsApp. We'll consult with top hospitals and
provide a detailed estimate within 24–48 hours, covering procedures, hospital stay, interpreter, and
logistics.

What payment methods are accepted through MedtourVietnam?

We accept major credit cards, bank transfers (local & international), cash payments, and direct
billing with select international insurers. Let us know your preferred method and we’ll assist with
invoices or documentation.

What types of medical treatments are most popular among international patients?

Health checkups, orthopedic surgery, fertility care, cardiology, oncology, and cosmetic procedures
are among the most requested services offered through our accredited hospital network.

How does MedtourVietnam ensure patient privacy and confidentiality?

We comply with international data protection standards. All medical records are securely stored and
shared only with authorized professionals, with your full consent, under HIPAA-equivalent
safeguards.

Does MedtourVietnam provide support for post-treatment care?

Yes, we offer in-person hospital follow-ups and virtual support after your return, including
medication management, rehabilitation advice, and coordination with your home doctors.

How can I contact MedtourVietnam for further questions or urgent support?

Our international support team is available 24/7. Contact us via hotline, email, or WhatsApp for any
questions or urgent assistance throughout your treatment journey.

Get in touch with us and we’re happy to assist if you did not find the answer to your specific
question yet.

## 事業内容
## BUSINESS

### 特定細胞加工物製造業

再生医療等安全性確保法に基づく特定細胞加工物の製造を受託します。

[詳しく見る][85]

### CDMO事業

医薬品医療機器等法（薬機法）に基づく再生医療等製品・治験製品の工程開発から製造受託までトータルサポー
トで承ります。

[詳しく見る][86]

### バリューチェーン事業

再生医療の細胞加工に携わるすべてのお客様の業務負荷を軽減するためのソリューションを提供し、円滑な再生
医療の実施を支援いたします。

[詳しく見る][87]

### 自己がん組織バンク

将来のがん治療に備えて、がんの手術などで摘出した患者さんのがん組織を無償でお預かりします。

[詳しく見る][88]

### 免疫細胞治療とは

免疫細胞治療は、自分の免疫細胞を使ってがんを攻撃する治療法です。メディネットは創業以来、免疫細胞治療
の技術開発に取り組んでいます。

[詳しく見る][89]

医療の実施を支援いたします。

## **MM Medical: Your Partner for Lasting Pain Relief**

Are you exhausted from chronic knee pain dictating and limiting your daily life? At **MM Medical**,
we fully understand the profound and debilitating impact that osteoarthritis can have on your
overall well-being, which is why we are dedicated to providing advanced, non-surgical solutions that

revolutionary and cutting-edge procedure crafted to deliver significant, long-lasting relief from
knee pain that has plagued many for far too long.



Our mission is not just to alleviate your pain, but also to empower you to regain your mobility,
rediscover your independence, and return to the activities you love and cherish, all without the
burdensome weight of constant discomfort. We are unwavering in our commitment to personalized care,
utilizing state-of-the-art technology combined with a compassionate, patient-centered approach to
ensure the best possible outcomes for every individual we serve. Your journey to a pain-free life
begins with us.

**Frequently Asked Questions**

We provide answers to common questions about treatments, recovery, and orthopedic care for better
understanding.
* ### What is Genicular Artery Embolization (GAE)?
  
  **Genicular Artery Embolization (GAE)** is a minimally invasive, non-surgical procedure used to
  treat chronic knee pain caused by osteoarthritis. It involves blocking small blood vessels in the
  knee that are contributing to inflammation and pain.
* ### How does GAE work?
  
  A doctor uses a tiny catheter to access the inflamed arteries in your knee. They then inject
  microscopic particles that safely and effectively block blood flow to the inflamed areas,
  significantly reducing pain and swelling.
* ### Is GAE a surgical procedure?
  
  No, GAE is a non-surgical procedure. It is performed through a small incision in the groin or
  wrist and does not require general anesthesia or a hospital stay.
* ### What is the recovery time like?
  
  Recovery is typically very quick. Most patients can walk immediately after the procedure and
  return to their normal daily activities within a few days.
* ### What are the potential risks of GAE?
  
  GAE is considered a very safe procedure. Potential risks are minimal and may include minor
  bruising, temporary swelling, or discomfort at the injection site. Serious complications are
  extremely rare.

We provide answers to common questions about treatments, recovery, and orthopedic care for better
understanding.
* ### What is Genicular Artery Embolization (GAE)?
  
  **Genicular Artery Embolization (GAE)** is a minimally invasive, non-surgical procedure used to
  treat chronic knee pain caused by osteoarthritis. It involves blocking small blood vessels in the
  knee that are contributing to inflammation and pain.
* ### How does GAE work?
  
  A doctor uses a tiny catheter to access the inflamed arteries in your knee. They then inject
  microscopic particles that safely and effectively block blood flow to the inflamed areas,
  significantly reducing pain and swelling.
* ### Is GAE a surgical procedure?
  
  No, GAE is a non-surgical procedure. It is performed through a small incision in the groin or
  wrist and does not require general anesthesia or a hospital stay.
* ### What is the recovery time like?
  
  Recovery is typically very quick. Most patients can walk immediately after the procedure and
  return to their normal daily activities within a few days.
* ### What are the potential risks of GAE?
  
  GAE is considered a very safe procedure. Potential risks are minimal and may include minor
  bruising, temporary swelling, or discomfort at the injection site. Serious complications are
  extremely rare.

Welcome to NewGen! As a trusted medical device company supplying regenerative medicine products, we
are also dedicated to supporting healthcare providers in building their brand and advancing their
practice.

Our headquarters is based in Cleveland, Ohio, and we proudly serve medical offices and clinics
throughout the United States with premium-grade regenerative medicine solutions.

As a leading medical device distributor, we supply top-of-the-line Platelet Rich Plasma (PRP)  kits,
Bone Marrow Concentrate (BMC) devices,  Adipose Concentrating System (Progenikine), and a centrifuge
that has the ability to process all three kits

[A surgeon holding four fat graft syringes.][A surgeon holding four fat graft syringes.]

Our products have been proven effective in treating a variety of conditions such as pain management,
orthopedic conditions, erectile dysfunction, facelifts, hair loss, osteoarthritis, and more.

At NewGen, we are committed to staying ahead of the curve by keeping up to date with the latest
advancements in technology. We work closely with our customers to introduce new, safe, and proven
treatments to their practice.

Learn more about our comprehensive range of products and services below and contact us for more
information. Thank you for considering NewGen as your trusted medical device distributor.

  Shoulder Pain Treatment for Rotator Cuff Tears, Labrum Tears, Arthritis and Sports Injuries at One

  Patients wanting quicker healing may warrant adavanced [A2M PRP][42] for shoulders, which contains
  more growth factors than regular PRP and is longer lasting. 
  
  [Stem Cell][43] therapy for shoulders is for patients wanting premium healing in the quickest
  timeframe. 
  
  Some shoulders can easily be repaired without x rays or MRI imaging.
  
  Common patients needing imaging are suspected labrum tears and bone on bone shoulders without
  recent imaging done.
  
  Add on therapy for patients wanting shoulder pain healing include [Peptide][44] Therapy and
  Hyperbaric [Oxygen][45] Therapy
* ## NECK PAIN
  
  One Natural Health in Lincoln NE provides Neck Pain Treatment Relief with various injections
  including
  
  1.   [PRP][46] Therapy
  
  2.  Advanced [A2M][47] PRP
  
  3.  Stem [Cell][48] Therapy
  
  4.  [Ozone][49] Therapy
  
  The  neck history and current patient symptoms will guide our physician to the best neck treatment
  for the patient.  Injections can be paired with chiropractic care.  
  
  Recent neck x rays help guide the treatment plan but are not warranted in all cases.

  We utilize a combination of

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

# Specialists in Orthopedic Care

**Jerome R. Friedland, MD**
[[Orthopedic Medical Center]][143]

Welcome to **Orthopedic Medical Center - Reseda** located in Reseda, and Westlake Village.  We serve
the San Fernando Valley and Southern California and specialize in arthroscopy, sports medicine and
joint reconstruction and aims to restore function and activity to patients with individualized care.
For more than 20 years, Orthopedic Medical Center has been helping patients achieve quicker
recoveries while, at the same time, making them feel special.

Our skilled physicians and surgeons are each well-trained in their specialties to provide you with
the finest orthopedic care. We also offer unsurpassed convenience.

We provide a wide range of orthopedic services, including:
 
* Platelet-Rich Plasma Injections
* Joint Reconstruction
* Arthroscopy
* Sports Medicine
* Biologic Joint Reconstruction
* Trauma Care

Our office believes that patient education is an essential aspect of achieving a successful
treatment, as full knowledge can help patients make informed decisions about their treatment options
with the help of their doctor.

Each and every one of our patients is given the attention and respect they deserve when they visit
the office. We strive to provide a warm and welcoming office environment, and someone is always
available and willing to assist you with any questions or concerns you may have. Our top priorities
are ensuring patient comfort and providing the highest level of orthopedic care that we can.

If you are interested in learning more about our doctors and the services we offer, please call the
office today at **818.708.8100** to schedule a consultation. We always look forward to seeing new
patients.

Welcome to **Orthopedic Medical Center - Reseda** located in Reseda, and Westlake Village.  We serve

recoveries while, at the same time, making them feel special.

## How PRP Treatment Works

Platelet-Rich Plasma therapy harnesses your body's natural healing abilities to repair damaged
tissues and reduce pain.

01

### Blood Draw

A small sample of your blood is drawn and placed in a centrifuge to separate the platelets.

02

### PRP Preparation

The concentrated platelet-rich plasma is extracted, containing growth factors that promote healing.

03

### Targeted Injection

Using image guidance, the PRP is precisely injected into the injured area to stimulate repair.

## Faq’s

What Is PRP Facial?

Platelet Rich Plasma (PRP) is an injectable treatment, by which a person’s own blood is used.
Platelets are vital in the process of tissue healing, and the growth of new cells. PRP thereby
promotes collagen production, regenerates the skin tissue, and essentially re-energizes your cells
into rejuvenating themselves. The release of growth factors amphiphiles the healing process. PRP
softens fine lines and wrinkles, tightens the skin, and improves skin tone and texture. Panderma PRP
offers you high quality affordable prp kits.

Why Panderma ?

Here at Panderma we offer you high quality, affordable products to achieve the results your clients
deserve. We are also partnered with Doctor Wellness ® and their multi location training academies to
deliver the gold standards in training.
You will also receive a free listing on the Doctor Wellness ® clinic finder to drive clients

Our staff are here to assist you with client leaflets, social media post and stories, image libary,

Who Can Benefit Of A PRP Treatment For Hair Loss?

PRP hair restoration has created improvements for people experiencing:
Early male- or female-pattern baldness (androgenic alopecia)
Thinning hair on the scalp or along the hairline, especially near the temples
Metabolically induced hair thinning or loss
Fine or thinning hairs in the eyebrows or beard
PRP treatments can also be used preventatively to maintain your hair’s thickness over time.
Panderma PRP kits are designed to offer high quality PRP every time.

How Long Do PRP Hair Loss Treatment Results Last?

Results often last 6 to 12 months, but this varies from person to person. It takes about 3 months to
see optimal results and determine whether you’ll need additional sessions to achieve your ideal
outcome. Studies have shown PRP can significantly increase hair count and hair density within these
first 3 months. Once you’re happy with your growth, you can maintain it with treatments once or
twice a year or more as needed. Panderma PRP advice you discuss this with your practitioner.

What Is The Downtime Like After A PRP Hair Loss Treatment?

There is little to no downtime involved, as the treatment only involves a quick blood draw and a few
injections into the scalp. It’s normal to experience some temporary soreness and redness near your
injection sites, but this typically resolves in less than a day. You can resume desk work, workouts,
washing your hair, and all other daily activities right away. Panderma PRP offers the results your
client deserves.

How Should I Prepare for a PRP Hair Treatment?

For at least 48 hours and up to a week before your treatment, avoid blood-thinning medications and
supplements (with your doctor’s permission), as well as NSAIDs, alcohol, and anti-inflammatory
medications. You do not need to shave your hair before your treatment. On the day of your session,
plan to arrive with clean hair free of any gels, sprays, or styling products. Please follow the
advice of your PANDERMA practitioner.

Why Should I Choose PRP Over Other Hair Restoration Treatments?

PRP is an excellent minimally invasive alternative to more involved hair restoration solutions, such
as FUT or FUE grafting. It involves little to no downtime compared to other options and stimulates
your own natural hair growth rather than patching in areas with grafts from elsewhere on the head.
While this treatment isn’t right for everyone, it can provide noticeable results for the right
candidates. Your Panderma PRP consultant will advice you on the best treatments.

How Is PRP Administered?

The treatment of PRP involves a fraction of blood, collected or ‘drawn up’ from the individual
patient into a syringe. The collected blood is then spun down in a special centrifuge to separate
its components. The platelet rich plasma is then reinjected, and/or micro-needled back into the
skin. Panderma is a high quality affordable solution for PRP treatments.

How Long Does A PRP Treatment Take?

Typically, a Panderma PRP treatment takes between an hour or two to complete. This depends on if the
PRP is administered through injections only, and/or micro-needled into the skin. This timeframe
includes an additional 30 minutes for the blood to be drawn and spun in the centrifuge, and topical
numbing to be applied.

Do PRP Injections Hurt?

Some mild discomfort may be felt while the Panderma PRP is being reinjected. The sensation typically
felt is a burning or tingling sensation. This sensation only lasts a few minutes after the PRP
injected. We ensure our patients are comfortable throughout the entire PRP treatment and apply
topical numbing cream and ice to aid any discomfort.

When Will I Begin To See Results From A PRP Treatment?

Generally, Panderma PRP patients notice tightening and a more even tone to their skin in a week or
two after PRP injections. These results continue to build for up to 6 months after treatment.

What Areas Can I Treat With PRP Injections?

Technically, PRP can used to treat all area of the body. For cosmetic purposes, Panderma PRP is most
popularly used to treat the face and neck and scalp.

How Many PRP Treatments Will I Need?

Results can be seen after one treatment , but the exact number of treatments needed varies from
patient to patient and treatment areas. Generally, 2‐3 treatments are advised, but more may be
indicated for some individuals.

Are There Any Side Effects Or Possible Risks To PRP Injections?

Panderma PRP used for aesthetic procedures are safe for most individuals. There are very few
contraindications with PRP injections. The most common side effects associated with PRP injections
are mild to moderate swelling and redness.

Who Is NOT A Candidate For PRP Injections?

During your consultation, and assessment will be made to ensure you are the right candidate for PRP
injections. Patients with certain health conditions are not a candidate for PRP injections. Patients
who are pregnant are not candidates for PRP injections.

## Faq’s

What Is PRP Facial?

Platelet Rich Plasma (PRP) is an injectable treatment, by which a person’s own blood is used.
Platelets are vital in the process of tissue healing, and the growth of new cells. PRP thereby
promotes collagen production, regenerates the skin tissue, and essentially re-energizes your cells
into rejuvenating themselves. The release of growth factors amphiphiles the healing process. PRP
softens fine lines and wrinkles, tightens the skin, and improves skin tone and texture. Panderma PRP
offers you high quality affordable prp kits.

Why Panderma ?

Here at Panderma we offer you high quality, affordable products to achieve the results your clients
deserve. We are also partnered with Doctor Wellness ® and their multi location training academies to
deliver the gold standards in training.
You will also receive a free listing on the Doctor Wellness ® clinic finder to drive clients
straight to your door.
Our staff are here to assist you with client leaflets, social media post and stories, image libary,
consent forms and more.

Who Can Benefit Of A PRP Treatment For Hair Loss?

PRP hair restoration has created improvements for people experiencing:
Early male- or female-pattern baldness (androgenic alopecia)
Thinning hair on the scalp or along the hairline, especially near the temples
Metabolically induced hair thinning or loss
Fine or thinning hairs in the eyebrows or beard
PRP treatments can also be used preventatively to maintain your hair’s thickness over time.
Panderma PRP kits are designed to offer high quality PRP every time.

How Long Do PRP Hair Loss Treatment Results Last?

Results often last 6 to 12 months, but this varies from person to person. It takes about 3 months to
see optimal results and determine whether you’ll need additional sessions to achieve your ideal
outcome. Studies have shown PRP can significantly increase hair count and hair density within these
first 3 months. Once you’re happy with your growth, you can maintain it with treatments once or
twice a year or more as needed. Panderma PRP advice you discuss this with your practitioner.

What Is The Downtime Like After A PRP Hair Loss Treatment?

There is little to no downtime involved, as the treatment only involves a quick blood draw and a few
injections into the scalp. It’s normal to experience some temporary soreness and redness near your
injection sites, but this typically resolves in less than a day. You can resume desk work, workouts,
washing your hair, and all other daily activities right away. Panderma PRP offers the results your
client deserves.

How Should I Prepare for a PRP Hair Treatment?

For at least 48 hours and up to a week before your treatment, avoid blood-thinning medications and
supplements (with your doctor’s permission), as well as NSAIDs, alcohol, and anti-inflammatory
medications. You do not need to shave your hair before your treatment. On the day of your session,
plan to arrive with clean hair free of any gels, sprays, or styling products. Please follow the
advice of your PANDERMA practitioner.

Why Should I Choose PRP Over Other Hair Restoration Treatments?

PRP is an excellent minimally invasive alternative to more involved hair restoration solutions, such
as FUT or FUE grafting. It involves little to no downtime compared to other options and stimulates
your own natural hair growth rather than patching in areas with grafts from elsewhere on the head.
While this treatment isn’t right for everyone, it can provide noticeable results for the right
candidates. Your Panderma PRP consultant will advice you on the best treatments.

How Is PRP Administered?

The treatment of PRP involves a fraction of blood, collected or ‘drawn up’ from the individual
patient into a syringe. The collected blood is then spun down in a special centrifuge to separate
its components. The platelet rich plasma is then reinjected, and/or micro-needled back into the
skin. Panderma is a high quality affordable solution for PRP treatments.

How Long Does A PRP Treatment Take?

Typically, a Panderma PRP treatment takes between an hour or two to complete. This depends on if the
PRP is administered through injections only, and/or micro-needled into the skin. This timeframe
includes an additional 30 minutes for the blood to be drawn and spun in the centrifuge, and topical
numbing to be applied.

Do PRP Injections Hurt?

Some mild discomfort may be felt while the Panderma PRP is being reinjected. The sensation typically
felt is a burning or tingling sensation. This sensation only lasts a few minutes after the PRP
injected. We ensure our patients are comfortable throughout the entire PRP treatment and apply
topical numbing cream and ice to aid any discomfort.

When Will I Begin To See Results From A PRP Treatment?

Generally, Panderma PRP patients notice tightening and a more even tone to their skin in a week or
two after PRP injections. These results continue to build for up to 6 months after treatment.

What Areas Can I Treat With PRP Injections?

Technically, PRP can used to treat all area of the body. For cosmetic purposes, Panderma PRP is most
popularly used to treat the face and neck and scalp.

How Many PRP Treatments Will I Need?

Results can be seen after one treatment , but the exact number of treatments needed varies from
patient to patient and treatment areas. Generally, 2‐3 treatments are advised, but more may be
indicated for some individuals.

Are There Any Side Effects Or Possible Risks To PRP Injections?

Panderma PRP used for aesthetic procedures are safe for most individuals. There are very few
contraindications with PRP injections. The most common side effects associated with PRP injections
are mild to moderate swelling and redness.

Who Is NOT A Candidate For PRP Injections?

During your consultation, and assessment will be made to ensure you are the right candidate for PRP
injections. Patients with certain health conditions are not a candidate for PRP injections. Patients
who are pregnant are not candidates for PRP injections.

includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

**Conference Benefits:**

•   Live Sessions
•   Certification of Recognition
•   Meet your Academic idols
•   Hear about latest research
•   Engage in High level debates & Q/A
•   Networking for future collaboration
•   Add Research Value
•   Networking Sessions

**Target Audience**
* Pharma Research Community
* R&D Researchers from Pharma Industries
* Directors of Organizations
* CEO's of Organizations
* Business Development Managers
* Chief Scientific Officers
* Academia
* Drug Delivery Entities
* Medical Groups
* Related Associations
* Biomedical Device Industries
* Medical Device Industries

 

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

ПЛЕЧО.РУ создан группой ведущих врачей специалистов в области спортивной травматологии и ортопедии
города Москвы.


ПЛЕЧО.РУ в доступной форме познакомит Вас с возможностями современной травматологии, ортопедии и
реабилитации.


ПЛЕЧО.РУ это эффективность, надежность и безопасность современной Артроскопии!


Наша группа врачей специалистов по диагностике, лечению, реабилитации заболеваний и травм плечевого
сустава ставит своей задачей улучшение функциональных результатов лечения наших пациентов путем
преемственности и совместной работы на всех этапах: диагностическом, хирургическом и
восстановительном.

Кроме того, работая в составе международных исследовательских групп и участвуя во всех крупных
международных конгрессах в Европе и Америке, мы можем предложить нашим пациентам наиболее адекватные
современные методы лечения, включая авторские методики.


ПЛЕЧО.РУ-точная диагностика, детальное планирование лечения, малотравматичная и артроскопическая
хирургия, реабилитация и ЛФК.

ПЛЕЧО.РУ создан группой ведущих врачей специалистов в области спортивной травматологии и ортопедии
города Москвы.


ПЛЕЧО.РУ в доступной форме познакомит Вас с возможностями современной травматологии, ортопедии и
реабилитации.


ПЛЕЧО.РУ это эффективность, надежность и безопасность современной Артроскопии!


Наша группа врачей специалистов по диагностике, лечению, реабилитации заболеваний и травм плечевого
сустава ставит своей задачей улучшение функциональных результатов лечения наших пациентов путем
преемственности и совместной работы на всех этапах: диагностическом, хирургическом и
восстановительном.

Кроме того, работая в составе международных исследовательских групп и участвуя во всех крупных
международных конгрессах в Европе и Америке, мы можем предложить нашим пациентам наиболее адекватные
современные методы лечения, включая авторские методики.


ПЛЕЧО.РУ-точная диагностика, детальное планирование лечения, малотравматичная и артроскопическая
хирургия, реабилитация и ЛФК.

leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

[Rendering einer bottelpack Anlage bp550]

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

[BFS entdecken][42]
[bottelpack Anlagen entdecken][43]
[Rendering von BFS Ampullen]

cdmo

## BFS-Lohnabfüllung und Entwicklung

Ganz gleich, ob Sie die BFS-Technologie ohne großes Investitionsrisiko testen möchten,
Produktionsspitzen abdecken oder Marktchargen vollständig produzieren wollen – unsere
**[Lohnabfüllung][44] **bietet Ihnen modernste Anlagen und ein umfassendes Servicepaket zu äußerst
wettbewerbsfähigen Preisen.

Zudem bietet unser erfahrenes Team umfassende Unterstützung bei der **Entwicklung **und Optimierung
Ihres Produkts für die Blow-Fill-Seal-Technologie.

## Does your PRP system really work?

Most clinics are not unlocking the full potential of platelet-rich plasma. Gel separator tubes trap
a significant proportion of platelets, often producing a concentration of only around 1×. Activators
containing bovine thrombin may also carry a risk of clotting disorders and immune reactions. The
result is a less effective PRP preparation, less predictable clinical outcomes, and patients who
don’t achieve the results they were hoping for.

Y-Cellbio PRP tubes and the RVC002 centrifuge were developed to solve this problem—delivering a
validated, consistent PRP preparation process that recovers platelets often lost by conventional
systems.

01
RVC002
Clinical Centrifuge
Low-speed. Pre-programmed. Precise.
Manual spin settings are where consistency breaks down. The RVC002 runs a pre-programmed double-spin
protocol for PRP, bone marrow and PRF. No RPM guesswork, no operator error. Compact, quiet and
steel-built with safety interlocks and fault diagnostics.
[Request information →][27]
02
Y-Cellbio
PRP Tube System
No gel. No activators. Just results.
The Y-Cellbio Certified PRP Tube System is designed to produce platelet-rich plasma with a platelet
concentration exceeding 1 million platelets/µL in a single centrifugation cycle. This is made
possible by the system's unique, patented Y-shaped tube design. Combined with a simple preparation
protocol and certified single-use kits, the Y-Cellbio system helps minimize the risk of
complications associated with PRP injections while ensuring a safe, consistent, and reliable
treatment process.

clinicians can consistently achieve this level of concentration. The result is a reliable,
standardized foundation for regenerative treatments involving joints, skin, hair, and soft tissues.

## Does your PRP system really work?

Most clinics are not unlocking the full potential of platelet-rich plasma. Gel separator tubes trap
a significant proportion of platelets, often producing a concentration of only around 1×. Activators
containing bovine thrombin may also carry a risk of clotting disorders and immune reactions. The
result is a less effective PRP preparation, less predictable clinical outcomes, and patients who
don’t achieve the results they were hoping for.

Y-Cellbio PRP tubes and the RVC002 centrifuge were developed to solve this problem—delivering a
validated, consistent PRP preparation process that recovers platelets often lost by conventional
systems.

Clinical Centrifuge
Low-speed. Pre-programmed. Precise.
Manual spin settings are where consistency breaks down. The RVC002 runs a pre-programmed double-spin
protocol for PRP, bone marrow and PRF. No RPM guesswork, no operator error. Compact, quiet and
steel-built with safety interlocks and fault diagnostics.
[Request information →][27]
02
Y-Cellbio
PRP Tube System
No gel. No activators. Just results.
The Y-Cellbio Certified PRP Tube System is designed to produce platelet-rich plasma with a platelet
concentration exceeding 1 million platelets/µL in a single centrifugation cycle. This is made
possible by the system's unique, patented Y-shaped tube design. Combined with a simple preparation
protocol and certified single-use kits, the Y-Cellbio system helps minimize the risk of
complications associated with PRP injections while ensuring a safe, consistent, and reliable
treatment process.

clinicians can consistently achieve this level of concentration. The result is a reliable,
standardized foundation for regenerative treatments involving joints, skin, hair, and soft tissues.

health. Founded in Reston, Virginia, as a private medical center at the forefront of advanced spine
restoration, we offer personalized treatments for neck and back pain, as well as other spine and
orthopedic conditions.

gerekliliklerine uygun şekilde yürütülmektedir.

treatment variant. Scope Heal helps you compare qualified aesthetic practitioners across London so
you can make an informed choice before booking.

# OUR SERVICES

[[gp website .jpg]][55]

## GENERAL PRACTICE

We offer a full range of general medical services, including check-ups, chronic disease management,
and preventative health care.

[ ][56]
[hyperbaric website .jpg]

## HYPERBARIC OXYGEN CHAMBER

Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy raises the level of oxygen in the blood to stimulate healing processes,
increase stamina, promote relaxation and more.

[ ][57]
[_prp website .jpg]

## PLATELET-RICH PLASMA (PRP)

PRP is an autologous blood derivative – it is a component of blood from the same patient that it is
used to treat. PRP is a safe and natural alternative to drugs and surgery.

[ ][58]
[face prp website .jpg]

## COSMETIC PRP

Cosmetic PRP, also known as the famous 'Vampire Facial', is a revolutionary cosmetic treatment that
rejuvenates the skin, resulting in a youthful appearance.  

[ ][59]
[xcell website (1).jpg]

## XCELL THERAPY

XCell therapy is a revolutionary treatment that uses blood-derived cells to promote healing. It can
treat many illnesses and enhance appearance and wellbeing.

[ ][60]
[genital prp website (1).jpg]

## GENITAL PRP

Suitable for men and women, PRP can be used to treat conditions associated with genital function.
These conditions include erectile dysfunction and urinary incontinence.

[ ][61]
[mygene website (1).jpg]

## MY GENE TEST

The MyGene Test uses your DNA and lifestyle data to deliver personalised insights to support your
health and wellbeing.

[ ][62]
[hair prp website (1).jpg]

## HAIR RESTORATION

PRP therapy is a new, natural, non-surgical option for patients experiencing hair loss. The cells
and growth factors in PRP encourages the growth of hair follicles.

# Orthopedic Surgery & Sports Medicine

Located In Dallas, Fort Worth, Keller, Plano, And Weatherford, TX

#### Providers

[People Icon]

#### Locations

[Locations Pin Icon]

#### Book an appointment

## About Our Practice

For more than 30 years, Texas Orthopaedic Associates has provided comprehensive orthopedic care to
patients throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex. Our team of board-certified orthopedic surgeons
and musculoskeletal specialists diagnoses and treats a wide range of conditions affecting the bones,
joints, muscles, ligaments, tendons, and spine.

With state-of-the-art offices near the Presbyterian Hospital campus in Dallas and convenient
locations in Plano, Fort Worth, Keller, and Weatherford, Texas, patients have access to expert care
close to home. We specialize in sports medicine, joint replacement, spine care, hand and upper
extremity treatment, foot and ankle care, fracture care, and general orthopedics.

At Texas Orthopaedic Associates, we believe surgery is not always the first answer. Our physicians
are committed to helping patients find relief through conservative, non-surgical treatment options
whenever possible, including physical therapy, injections, bracing, and lifestyle modifications.
When surgery is necessary, our team utilizes advanced techniques and state-of-the-art technology to
help patients return to the activities they enjoy.

Whether you’re dealing with chronic joint pain, a sports injury, back or neck pain, arthritis, or a
workplace injury, Texas Orthopaedic Associates is dedicated to providing personalized treatment
plans focused on restoring mobility, reducing pain, and improving quality of life.

[Learn More][96]
[TOA Physical Therapy][97]

## Our Services

Our expertise and depth of experience make us the definitive choice for your orthopaedic needs.
Whether you are a star athlete or just seeking increased mobility without pain, the physicians and
staff at Texas Orthopaedic Associates want to offer you the least invasive treatment methods
possible. We invite you to schedule an appointment and learn more about how we can work together to
improve your health and quality of life

## About Our Practice

For more than 30 years, Texas Orthopaedic Associates has provided comprehensive orthopedic care to
patients throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex. Our team of board-certified orthopedic surgeons
and musculoskeletal specialists diagnoses and treats a wide range of conditions affecting the bones,
joints, muscles, ligaments, tendons, and spine.

With state-of-the-art offices near the Presbyterian Hospital campus in Dallas and convenient
locations in Plano, Fort Worth, Keller, and Weatherford, Texas, patients have access to expert care
close to home. We specialize in sports medicine, joint replacement, spine care, hand and upper
extremity treatment, foot and ankle care, fracture care, and general orthopedics.

At Texas Orthopaedic Associates, we believe surgery is not always the first answer. Our physicians
are committed to helping patients find relief through conservative, non-surgical treatment options
whenever possible, including physical therapy, injections, bracing, and lifestyle modifications.
When surgery is necessary, our team utilizes advanced techniques and state-of-the-art technology to
help patients return to the activities they enjoy.

Whether you’re dealing with chronic joint pain, a sports injury, back or neck pain, arthritis, or a
workplace injury, Texas Orthopaedic Associates is dedicated to providing personalized treatment
plans focused on restoring mobility, reducing pain, and improving quality of life.

# Клиника эстетической медицины Вирсавия

### Рублева Елена Сергеевна

Врач дерматовенеролог-косметолог, сертифицированный тренер компании INMODE (Инмод).

Стаж 12 лет

#### Образование
* 2004-2010 гг. "Оренбургская Государственная Медицинская Академия" г. Оренбург. Специальность -
  лечебное дело.
* 2010-2011 гг. Оренбургская Государственная Медицинская Академия" г. Оренбург. Специальность -
  Терапия
* 2015 г. "Академия образования Планета Красоты" г. Москва. Специальность - Косметология
* 2016 г. "Оренбургский Государственный Медицинский Университет" г. Оренбург Специальность -
  Дерматовенерология
* 2020 г. "Институт Инновационных Технологий" г. Оренбург. Специальность - Терапия.
* 2020 г. "Институт Инновационных Технологий" г. Оренбург. Специальность - Организация здоровья и
  общественного здравоохранения.
* 2020 г. "Институт Инновационных Технологий" г. Оренбург. Специальность - дерматовенерология.
* 2023 г. "Межрегиональный институт подготовки кадров" г. Москва. Специальность - косметология.
* 2024 г. "Научно-инновационный институт профессиональной переподготовки и повышения квалификации" —
  повышение квалификации "Организация здоровья и общественного здравоохранения".
* 2024 г. "Научно-инновационный институт профессиональной переподготовки и повышения квалификации" —
  повышение квалификации "Дерматовенерология"
* 2025 г. Аккредитация по профилю Косметология — ФГБОУ ВЫСШЕГО ОБРАЗОВАНИЯ "ЧГМА" МЗ РФ

#### Опыт

Обладатель различных дипломов и сертификатов по инъекционным и аппаратным методикам. Регулярно
посещает российские и международные конгрессы, симпозиумы, тренинги, посвященные эстетической
косметологии.
* 2015-2018 гг. Курсы повышения квалификации в области инъекционной косметологии (работа с
  препаратами - Juvederm (Ювидерм), Princess (Принцесс), Belotero (Белотеро), Restylane (Рестилайн),
  Radiesse (Радиесс), Dysport (Диспорт), Botox (Ботокс), Xeomin (Ксеомин), Filorga (Филорга),
  Mesosculpt (Мезоскальпт), Mesoeye (Мезоай), MesoWarton (Мезовартон), MesoXanthin (Мезоксантин),
  MesoGenesis (Мезогенезис), Revi (Реви), Reneall (Ренеалл), Collost (Коллост), Amalain (Амалайн),
  PRP терапия, Martinex (Мартинекс), Тредлифтинг мезонитями, когами, Нити пдо коги, Аптос)
* 2019-2021 гг. Курсы повышения квалификации в области инъекционной косметологии (работа с
  препаратами - Мелсмон, Лаеннек, Curacen (Курасен), Radiesse (Радиесс), Dysport (Диспорт), Xeomin
  (Ксеомин), Platinum (Платинум), Revi (Реви), Mesosculpt (Мезоскальпт), Mesoeye (Мезоай),
  MesoWarton (Мезовартон), MesoXanthin (Мезоксантин), MesoGenesis (Мезогенезис), Juvederm (Ювидерм),
  Plinest (Плинест), нити Ewa innolift (Эва Иннолифт), нити Cara (Кара)).
* 2022-2023 гг. Курсы повышения квалификации в области инъекционной косметологии (работа с
  препаратами - Nithya (Нития), Nithya S-line (Нития С-лайн), Collost (Коллост), Collost Micro
  (Коллост Микро), Skinko (Скинко), Сферогель, Релатокс).
* 2020-2023 гг. Курсы повышения квалификации в области аппаратной косметологии (Deka (Дека), Secret
  RF (Сикрет РФ), Skin Perfect (Скин Перфект), Heleo (Хелео), Beautylaser (Бьютилайзер), М22, Bbl
  (Ббл), Morpheus (Морфеус), Lumeka (Люмека), Ultraformer MPT (Ультраформер МПТ), Ulthera (Альтера),
  Candella (Кандела))
* 2024 г. Повышение квалификации - Сферогель, Bbl (Ббл), Morpheus (Морфеус), Acupals (Акупалс),
  Миотокс.

ЛОР-заболеваний — затяжного ринита;
желудочно-кишечного тракта — хронического гастрита, запоров, язвы желудка и двенадцатиперстной

[[Центр аппаратной косметологии Вирсавия - фото №1]][27]

В Центре представлены самые эффективные технологии и методики, позволяющие решать широкий спектр
косметических проблем. Сейчас предлагается огромный выбор методик и препаратов, однако, прежде чем
предложить то или иное средство, мы проводим тщательный отбор, и только безопасные и эффективные
продукты имеют место быть в Центре Вирсавия. Недостаточно иметь хорошее, должно быть лучшее. И мы
готовы предложить Вам лучшее — Вы этого достойны!

[Центр аппаратной косметологии Вирсавия - фото №2]

> **Клиника «Вирсавия» более 20 лет работает в сфере эстетической медицины. Все процедуры в центре
> выполняются врачами-косметологами с профильным медицинским образованием и клиническим стажем от 10
> лет. **

Каждый пациент проходит обязательную очную консультацию, в ходе которой врач оценивает состояние
кожи, собирает анамнез, анализирует образ жизни и индивидуальные особенности, после чего формирует
персональный план процедур с учётом показаний и противопоказаний. Мы не используем универсальные
решения и подходим к выбору методик индивидуально.

В центре представлены современные аппаратные и инъекционные методики, позволяющие решать широкий
спектр эстетических задач. Сегодня рынок эстетической медицины предлагает большое количество
технологий и препаратов, однако в клинике «Вирсавия» применяется принцип тщательного
профессионального отбора.

> ** Клиника оснащена современным оборудованием ведущих мировых производителей, включая платформы
> InMode (Инмод). Это позволяет врачам подбирать оптимальные методы коррекции с учётом состояния
> кожи, возраста и индивидуальных задач пациента. **

> **Клиника расположена в центре Москвы, в шаговой доступности от метро, и создаёт комфортную и
> спокойную атмосферу для посещения. Мы придерживаемся принципов медицинской этики, деликатного
> общения и внимательного отношения к каждому пациенту, независимо от поставленных задач и выбранных
> методик. **

Мы рассматриваем эстетическую медицину как системную работу с кожей и организмом в целом,
направленную на поддержание здоровья, качества кожи и уверенности пациента в своём выборе.

решения и подходим к выбору методик индивидуально.

В центре представлены современные аппаратные и инъекционные методики, позволяющие решать широкий
спектр эстетических задач. Сегодня рынок эстетической медицины предлагает большое количество
технологий и препаратов, однако в клинике «Вирсавия» применяется принцип тщательного
профессионального отбора.

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]
